title.zh: 卷七十九 志第二十九: 輿服二
title.raw: 卷七十九 志第二十九: 輿服二 Volume 79 Treatises 32: Carriages and Clothes 2

sentences.zh: 輿服二 ○儀仗

translations.literal: Carriages and Attire II ○ Ceremonial Insignia
translations.idiomatic: Carriages and Attire, Part Two — Ceremonial Insignia

sentences.zh: 皂纛，

translations.literal: Black standard,
translations.idiomatic: The black standard,

sentences.zh: （國語讀如禿。）〉

translations.literal: (In the national language it is pronounced like tū, "bald.") )
translations.idiomatic: (In the national language it is pronounced like tū, "bald.") )

sentences.zh: 建纓於素漆竿。

translations.literal: A tassel was erected on a plain lacquered pole.
translations.idiomatic: A tassel was mounted on a plain lacquered staff.

sentences.zh: 凡行幸，則先驅建纛，夾以馬鼓，居則置纛於月華門西之隅室。

translations.literal: Whenever the emperor traveled on tour, vanguard bearers raised the standard, flanked by horse-drums; when at rest it was placed in the corner chamber west of the Moon Splendor Gate.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever the emperor went on tour, vanguard bearers raised this standard, flanked by horse-drums; when the court was at rest, the standard was kept in the corner chamber west of the Moon Splendor Gate.

sentences.zh: 絳麾，金塗竿，上施圓盤朱絲拂，三層，紫羅袋韜之。

translations.literal: Crimson banner-staff: a gold-gilt pole, with round disks and vermilion silk tassels in three tiers, sheathed in a purple silk bag.
translations.idiomatic: The crimson banner-staff had a gold-gilt pole topped with three tiers of round disks and vermilion silk tassels, all kept in a purple silk cover.

sentences.zh: 金節，制如麾，八層，韜以黃羅雲龍袋。

translations.literal: Golden baton: made like the banner-staff, eight tiers, sheathed in a yellow silk bag embroidered with clouds and dragons.
translations.idiomatic: The golden baton matched the banner-staff in form but had eight tiers and was housed in a yellow silk bag embroidered with clouds and dragons.

sentences.zh: 又引導節，金塗龍頭朱漆竿，懸五色拂，上施銅鈸。

translations.literal: There was also the guiding baton: a gold-gilt dragon head on a vermilion-lacquered pole, with five-colored tassels suspended and bronze cymbals mounted above.
translations.idiomatic: There was also a guiding baton: a vermilion-lacquered pole with a gold-gilt dragon head, five-colored tassels hanging from it, and bronze cymbals at the top.

sentences.zh: 朱雀幢，制如節而五層，韜以紅繡朱雀袋。

translations.literal: Vermilion Bird pennant: made like the baton but with five tiers, sheathed in a red embroidered Vermilion Bird bag.
translations.idiomatic: The Vermilion Bird pennant was like the baton but had five tiers and was kept in a red embroidered bag bearing the Vermilion Bird.

sentences.zh: 青龍幢，制如前，韜以碧繡青龍袋。

translations.literal: Azure Dragon pennant: made as before, sheathed in an emerald-green embroidered Azure Dragon bag.
translations.idiomatic: The Azure Dragon pennant followed the same design and was kept in an emerald-green embroidered Azure Dragon bag.

sentences.zh: 白虎幢，制如前，韜以素繡白虎袋。

translations.literal: White Tiger pennant: made as before, sheathed in a plain white embroidered White Tiger bag.
translations.idiomatic: The White Tiger pennant followed the same pattern and was kept in a plain white embroidered White Tiger bag.

sentences.zh: 玄武幢，制如前，韜以皂繡玄武袋。

translations.literal: Black Tortoise pennant: made as before, sheathed in a black embroidered Black Tortoise bag.
translations.idiomatic: The Black Tortoise pennant followed the same pattern and was kept in a black embroidered Black Tortoise bag.

sentences.zh: 皞槊，制如節，頂刻皞牛首，有袋，上加碧油。

translations.literal: Hao spear: made like the baton, its top carved with a hao ox head, with a bag, and green oil applied above.
translations.idiomatic: The hao spear matched the baton in form, its top carved as a hao ox head, with a cover bag and green oil applied above.

sentences.zh: 絳引幡，四角，朱綠蓋，每角垂羅文雜佩，系於金銅鉤竿，竿以朱飾，懸五色間暈羅，下有橫木板，作碾玉文。

translations.literal: Crimson guiding pennant: four corners, a red-green canopy; at each corner hung mixed silk ornaments, attached to a gold-copper hook pole lacquered red; five-colored variegated silk was suspended, with a horizontal wooden board below bearing ground-jade patterns.
translations.idiomatic: The crimson guiding pennant had four corners and a red-green canopy; each corner bore mixed silk ornaments on a red-lacquered gold-copper hook pole, with five-colored variegated silk above a horizontal board carved in ground-jade patterns.

sentences.zh: 告止幡，緋帛錯彩為告止字，承以雙鳳，立仗者紅羅銷金升龍，余如絳引。

translations.literal: Stop pennant: crimson silk with variegated colors forming the characters for "stop"; borne by twin phoenixes; attendants wore red brocade with gold coiled dragons; the rest was like the crimson guiding pennant.
translations.idiomatic: The stop pennant used crimson silk embroidered in variegated colors with the word "stop," borne on twin phoenixes; attendants wore red brocade with gold coiled dragons, and the rest matched the crimson guiding pennant.

sentences.zh: 傳教幡，制如告止幡，錯彩為傳教字，承以雙白虎，立仗者白羅絳雲龍。

translations.literal: Transmit-teaching pennant: made like the stop pennant, with variegated colors forming the characters for "transmit teaching," borne by twin white tigers; attendants wore white brocade with crimson cloud-dragons.
translations.idiomatic: The transmit-teaching pennant matched the stop pennant, with variegated embroidery of "transmit teaching" borne on twin white tigers; attendants wore white brocade with crimson cloud-dragons.

sentences.zh: 信幡，制如傳教幡，錯彩為信字，承以雙龍，立仗者繪飛鳳。

translations.literal: Trust pennant: made like the transmit-teaching pennant, with variegated colors forming the character for "trust," borne by twin dragons; attendants were painted with flying phoenixes.
translations.idiomatic: The trust pennant matched the transmit-teaching pennant, with variegated embroidery of "trust" borne on twin dragons; attendants wore robes painted with flying phoenixes.

sentences.zh: 黃麾幡，制如信幡，錯彩為黃麾篆。

translations.literal: Yellow-banner pennant: made like the trust pennant, with variegated colors forming the seal-script characters for "yellow banner."
translations.idiomatic: The yellow-banner pennant matched the trust pennant, with variegated embroidery of the seal-script "yellow banner."

sentences.zh: 龍頭竿繡氅，竿如戟，無鉤，下有小橫木，刻龍頭，垂朱綠蓋，每角綴珠佩一帶，帶末有金銅鈴。

translations.literal: Dragon-head pole with embroidered streamers: the pole was like a halberd without a hook; below was a small crossbar carved as a dragon head, with a red-green canopy hanging; at each corner a strand of pearl ornaments, with gold-copper bells at the end of each strand.
translations.idiomatic: The dragon-head pole with embroidered streamers had a halberd-like shaft without a hook; a small crossbar below was carved as a dragon head, from which hung a red-green canopy; each corner bore a strand of pearl ornaments ending in gold-copper bells.

sentences.zh: 圍子，制以金塗攢竹杖，首貫銅錢，而以紫絹冒之。

translations.literal: Enclosure staff: made of gold-gilt bundled bamboo, the head strung with copper coins and covered with purple silk.
translations.idiomatic: The enclosure staff was made of gold-gilt bundled bamboo, its head strung with copper coins and wrapped in purple silk.

sentences.zh: 副竿，制以木，朱漆之。

translations.literal: Secondary pole: made of wood and lacquered vermilion.
translations.idiomatic: The secondary pole was wooden and lacquered vermilion.

sentences.zh: 火輪竿，制以白鐵，為小車輪，建於白鐵竿首。

translations.literal: Fire-wheel pole: made of white iron as a small cart wheel, mounted at the top of a white-iron pole.
translations.idiomatic: The fire-wheel pole was white iron shaped as a small cart wheel set atop a white-iron staff.

sentences.zh: 輪及竿皆金塗之，上書西天咒語，帝師所制。

translations.literal: Wheel and pole were both gold-gilt; upon them were written mantras of the Western Heaven, composed by the Imperial Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: Both wheel and pole were gold-gilt and bore mantras of the Western Heaven composed by the Imperial Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 常行為親衛中道，正行在劈正斧之前，以法佛衛，以祛邪僻，以鎮轟雷焉。

translations.literal: On ordinary processions it marched in the central path of the close guard; on formal processions it went before the cleaving axe, to guard by Buddhist law, to dispel evil and perversity, and to quell thunder.
translations.idiomatic: On ordinary processions it marched in the close guard's central lane; on formal processions it went before the cleaving axe to guard by Buddhist law, dispel evil, and quell thunder.

sentences.zh: 蓋辟惡車之意也。

translations.literal: This embodied the idea of a chariot that wards off evil.
translations.idiomatic: It embodied the idea of a chariot that wards off evil.

sentences.zh: 豹尾竿，制如戟，系豹尾，朱漆竿。

translations.literal: Leopard-tail pole: shaped like a halberd, with a leopard tail attached, on a vermilion-lacquered pole.
translations.idiomatic: The leopard-tail pole was halberd-shaped, with a leopard tail attached to a vermilion-lacquered staff.

sentences.zh: 寶輿方案，緋羅銷金雲龍案衣，緋羅銷金蒙襯復，案傍有金塗鐵鞠四，龍頭竿結綬二副之。

translations.literal: Imperial carriage table: crimson brocade case-cover with gold cloud-dragons, crimson brocade gold-lined backing; beside the table were four gold-gilt iron supports, with two dragon-head poles and tassel knots as adjuncts.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial carriage table had a crimson brocade cover with gold cloud-dragons and a gold-lined crimson backing; four gold-gilt iron supports stood beside it, with two dragon-head poles and tassel knots as adjuncts.

sentences.zh: 香蹬朱漆案，黃羅銷金雲龍案衣，上設金塗香爐一、燭臺二，案旁金塗鐵鞠四，龍頭竿結綬二副之。

translations.literal: Incense-step vermilion-lacquered table: yellow brocade case-cover with gold cloud-dragons; upon it one gold-gilt censer and two candlestands; beside the table four gold-gilt iron supports, with two dragon-head poles and tassel knots as adjuncts.
translations.idiomatic: The incense-step table was vermilion-lacquered with a yellow brocade cover bearing gold cloud-dragons; it held one gold-gilt censer and two candlestands, with four gold-gilt iron supports and two dragon-head poles with tassel knots as adjuncts.

sentences.zh: 香案朱漆案，緋羅銷金雲龍案衣，上設金香爐、合各一，余同香蹬，殿庭陳設，則除龍頭竿結綬。

translations.literal: Incense table, vermilion-lacquered: crimson brocade case-cover with gold cloud-dragons; upon it one gold incense burner and one casket each; the rest like the incense-step table; when set out in the palace courtyard, the dragon-head poles and tassel knots were omitted.
translations.idiomatic: The incense table was vermilion-lacquered with a crimson brocade cover bearing gold cloud-dragons; it held one gold incense burner and one casket; otherwise it matched the incense-step table, but in the palace courtyard the dragon-head poles and tassel knots were omitted.

sentences.zh: 詔案，制如香案。

translations.literal: Edict table: made like the incense table.
translations.idiomatic: The edict table matched the incense table.

sentences.zh: 冊案，制如前。

translations.literal: Register table: made as before.
translations.idiomatic: The register table was made in the same manner as before.

sentences.zh: 寶案，制如前。

translations.literal: Imperial seal table: made as before.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial seal table was made in the same manner as before.

sentences.zh: 表案，制如香案，上加矮闌，金塗鐵鞠四，竿二副之，緋羅銷金蒙復。

translations.literal: Memorial table: made like the incense table, with a low railing added above, four gold-gilt iron supports, two poles as adjuncts, and a crimson brocade gold-lined cover.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial table matched the incense table but had a low railing above, four gold-gilt iron supports, two adjunct poles, and a crimson brocade gold-lined cover.

sentences.zh: 禮物案，制如表案。

translations.literal: Gift table: made like the memorial table.
translations.idiomatic: The gift table matched the memorial table.

sentences.zh: 交椅，銀飾之，塗以黃金。

translations.literal: Folding chair: ornamented with silver and gilded with gold.
translations.idiomatic: The folding chair was ornamented with silver and gilded with gold.

sentences.zh: 杌子，四腳小床，銀飾之，塗以黃金。

translations.literal: Stool: a small four-legged bench, ornamented with silver and gilded with gold.
translations.idiomatic: The stool was a small four-legged bench, ornamented with silver and gilded with gold.

sentences.zh: 鳴鞭，綠柄，鞭以梅紅絲為之，梢用黃茸而漬以蠟。

translations.literal: Ceremonial whip: green handle; the lash was of plum-red silk, the tip yellow fur soaked in wax.
translations.idiomatic: The ceremonial whip had a green handle; the lash was plum-red silk, the tip yellow fur soaked in wax.

sentences.zh: 鞭桶，制以紫絁表，白絹裏，皮緣兩末。

translations.literal: Whip case: purple silk outside, white silk lining, leather edging at both ends.
translations.idiomatic: The whip case had purple silk outside, white silk lining, and leather edging at both ends.

sentences.zh: 蒙鞍，青錦綠，緋錦復。

translations.literal: Saddle cover: blue brocade outside, crimson brocade lining.
translations.idiomatic: The saddle cover was blue brocade outside and crimson brocade within.

sentences.zh: 水瓶，制如湯瓶，有蓋，有提，有觜，銀為之，塗以黃金。

translations.literal: Water flask: made like a hot-water ewer, with lid, handle, and spout; of silver, gilded with gold.
translations.idiomatic: The water flask was shaped like a hot-water ewer with lid, handle, and spout, of silver gilded with gold.

sentences.zh: 鹿盧，制如乂字，兩頭卷，塗金妝钑，朱絲繩副之。

translations.literal: Deer-horn rack: shaped like the character yi, both ends curled, gold-gilt and inlaid, with a vermilion silk cord as adjunct.
translations.idiomatic: The deer-horn rack was shaped like the character yi with curled ends, gold-gilt and inlaid, with a vermilion silk cord as adjunct.

sentences.zh: 水盆，黃金塗銀妝钑為之。

translations.literal: Water basin: of silver with gold gilding and inlaid ornament.
translations.idiomatic: The water basin was silver with gold gilding and inlaid ornament.

sentences.zh: 凈巾，緋羅銷金雲龍，有裏。

translations.literal: Purification towel: crimson brocade with gold cloud-dragons, lined.
translations.idiomatic: The purification towel was crimson brocade with gold cloud-dragons and had a lining.

sentences.zh: 香球，制以銀，為座上插蓮花爐，爐上罩以圓球，鏤氤氳旋轉文於上，黃金塗之。

translations.literal: Incense ball: of silver, a lotus censer set on a base, covered by a round sphere with openwork swirling vapor patterns, gold-gilt.
translations.idiomatic: The incense ball was silver: a lotus censer on a base beneath a round sphere with openwork swirling vapor patterns, all gold-gilt.

sentences.zh: 香合，制以銀，徑七寸，塗黃金钑雲龍於上。

translations.literal: Incense casket: of silver, seven inches in diameter, with gold-inlaid cloud-dragons on top.
translations.idiomatic: The incense casket was silver, seven inches across, with gold-inlaid cloud-dragons on top.

sentences.zh: 金拂，紅犛牛尾為之，黃金塗龍頭柄。

translations.literal: Gold whisk: of red yak tail, with a gold-gilt dragon-head handle.
translations.idiomatic: The gold whisk was made of red yak tail with a gold-gilt dragon-head handle.

sentences.zh: 唾壺，制以銀，寬緣，虛腹，有蓋，黃金塗之。

translations.literal: Spittoon: of silver, broad rim, hollow belly, with lid, gold-gilt.
translations.idiomatic: The spittoon was silver with a broad rim and hollow belly, lidded and gold-gilt.

sentences.zh: 唾盂，制以銀，形圓如缶，有蓋，黃金塗之。

translations.literal: Spit basin: of silver, round like a jar, with lid, gold-gilt.
translations.idiomatic: The spit basin was silver, round like a jar, lidded and gold-gilt.

sentences.zh: 外辦牌，制以象牙，書國字，背書漢字，填以金。

translations.literal: Outer preparation plaque: of ivory, inscribed in the national script on the face and in Chinese on the back, filled with gold.
translations.idiomatic: The outer preparation plaque was ivory, inscribed in the national script on the face and in Chinese on the back, filled with gold.

sentences.zh: 外備牌，制如前。

translations.literal: Outer reserve plaque: made as before.
translations.idiomatic: The outer reserve plaque was made in the same manner as before.

sentences.zh: 中嚴牌，制如前。

translations.literal: Inner vigil plaque: made as before.
translations.idiomatic: The inner vigil plaque was made in the same manner as before.

sentences.zh: 時牌，制同外備而小。

translations.literal: Time plaque: like the outer reserve but smaller.
translations.idiomatic: The time plaque matched the outer reserve but was smaller.

sentences.zh: 板位，制以木，長一尺二寸，闊一尺，厚六分，白髹黑字。

translations.literal: Position board: of wood, one foot two inches long, one foot wide, six fen thick, white-lacquered with black characters.
translations.idiomatic: The position board was wood, one foot two inches long, one foot wide, and six fen thick, white-lacquered with black characters.

sentences.zh: 大傘，赤質，正方，四角銅螭首，塗以黃金，紫羅表，緋絹裏。

translations.literal: Great umbrella: red body, square, with four bronze chi-dragon heads at the corners gilded with gold; purple silk outside, crimson silk lining.
translations.idiomatic: The great umbrella had a red square canopy with four bronze chi-dragon heads at the corners gilded with gold, purple silk outside and crimson silk within.

sentences.zh: 諸傘蓋，宋以前皆平頂，今加金浮屠。

translations.literal: All umbrella canopies before the Song were flat-topped; now a gold stupa is added.
translations.idiomatic: Before the Song, all umbrella canopies were flat-topped; now a gold stupa is added.

sentences.zh: 紫方傘，制如大傘而表以紫羅。

translations.literal: Purple square umbrella: made like the great umbrella but covered outside with purple silk.
translations.idiomatic: The purple square umbrella matched the great umbrella but was covered outside with purple silk.

sentences.zh: 紅方傘，制如大傘而表以緋羅。

translations.literal: Red square umbrella: made like the great umbrella but covered outside with crimson silk.
translations.idiomatic: The red square umbrella matched the great umbrella but was covered outside with crimson silk.

sentences.zh: 華蓋，制如傘而圓頂隆起，赤質，繡雜花雲龍，上施金浮屠。

translations.literal: Ornamental canopy: made like an umbrella but with a rounded raised top, red body, embroidered with mixed flowers and cloud-dragons, with a gold stupa above.
translations.idiomatic: The ornamental canopy was umbrella-like but with a rounded raised top, red body, embroidered with mixed flowers and cloud-dragons, and a gold stupa above.

sentences.zh: 曲蓋，制如華蓋，緋瀝水，繡瑞草，曲柄，上施金浮屠。

translations.literal: Curved canopy: made like the ornamental canopy, crimson drip-fringe, embroidered with auspicious plants, curved handle, with a gold stupa above.
translations.idiomatic: The curved canopy matched the ornamental canopy, with crimson drip-fringe embroidered with auspicious plants, a curved handle, and a gold stupa above.

sentences.zh: 導蓋，制如曲蓋，緋羅瀝水，繡龍，朱漆直柄。

translations.literal: Processional canopy: made like the curved canopy, crimson silk drip-fringe embroidered with dragons, vermilion-lacquered straight handle.
translations.idiomatic: The processional canopy matched the curved canopy, with crimson silk drip-fringe embroidered with dragons and a vermilion-lacquered straight handle.

sentences.zh: 朱傘，制如導蓋而無文。

translations.literal: Vermilion umbrella: made like the processional canopy but without pattern.
translations.idiomatic: The vermilion umbrella matched the processional canopy but had no pattern.

sentences.zh: 黃傘，制如朱傘而色黃。

translations.literal: Yellow umbrella: made like the vermilion umbrella but yellow in color.
translations.idiomatic: The yellow umbrella matched the vermilion umbrella but was yellow.

sentences.zh: 葆蓋，金塗龍頭竿，懸以纓絡，銷金圓裙，六角葆蓋。

translations.literal: Trefoil canopy: gold-gilt dragon-head pole, with tassels and knotted cords suspended, gold-inlaid round skirt, hexagonal trefoil canopy.
translations.idiomatic: The trefoil canopy had a gold-gilt dragon-head pole with suspended tassels and knotted cords, a gold-inlaid round skirt, and a hexagonal trefoil canopy.

sentences.zh: 孔雀蓋，朱漆，竿首建小蓋，蓋頂以孔雀毛，徑尺許，下垂孔雀尾，檐下以青黃紅瀝水圍之，上施金浮屠，蓋居竿三之一，竿塗以黃金，書西天咒語，與火輪竿義同。

translations.literal: Peacock canopy: vermilion lacquer; a small canopy at the pole top with peacock feathers about one foot across, peacock tail hanging below; beneath the eaves green, yellow, and red drip-fringe; gold stupa above; the canopy occupied one-third of the pole; the pole was gold-gilt with Western Heaven mantras, of the same meaning as the fire-wheel pole.
translations.idiomatic: The peacock canopy was vermilion lacquer; a small canopy at the staff top bore peacock feathers about a foot across with the tail hanging below; green, yellow, and red drip-fringe circled the eaves; a gold stupa crowned it; the canopy occupied one-third of the staff, which was gold-gilt and bore Western Heaven mantras, sharing the meaning of the fire-wheel pole.

sentences.zh: 朱團扇，緋羅繡盤龍，朱漆柄，金銅飾，導駕團扇，蹙金線。

translations.literal: Vermilion round fan: crimson silk embroidered with a coiled dragon, vermilion-lacquered handle with gold-copper fittings; processional round fans used puckered gold thread.
translations.idiomatic: The vermilion round fan was crimson silk embroidered with a coiled dragon on a vermilion-lacquered handle with gold-copper fittings; processional round fans used puckered gold thread.

sentences.zh: 大雉扇，制稍長，下方而上撱，緋羅繡象雉尾，中有雙孔雀，間以雜花，下施朱漆橫木連柄，金銅裝。

translations.literal: Large pheasant fan: somewhat longer, narrow above and broad below, crimson silk embroidered like an elephant-pheasant tail, with twin peacocks amid mixed flowers; below, a vermilion-lacquered crossbar joined to the handle, with gold-copper fittings.
translations.idiomatic: The large pheasant fan was somewhat longer, narrow above and broad below, crimson silk embroidered like an elephant-pheasant tail with twin peacocks amid mixed flowers, with a vermilion-lacquered crossbar joining the gold-copper-fitted handle below.

sentences.zh: 中雉扇，制如大雉扇而減小。

translations.literal: Medium pheasant fan: made like the large pheasant fan but reduced in size.
translations.idiomatic: The medium pheasant fan matched the large pheasant fan but was smaller.

sentences.zh: 小雉扇，制如中雉扇而減小。

translations.literal: Small pheasant fan: made like the medium pheasant fan but reduced in size.
translations.idiomatic: The small pheasant fan matched the medium pheasant fan but was smaller.

sentences.zh: 青瀝水扇，制圓而青色，四周瀝水以青絹。

translations.literal: Blue drip-fringe fan: round and blue, with blue silk drip-fringe all around.
translations.idiomatic: The blue drip-fringe fan was round and blue, with blue silk drip-fringe all around.

sentences.zh: NV，朱縢結網，二螭首，銜紅絲拂，中有獸面，朱漆柄，金銅裝。

translations.literal: Sha (ceremonial plumes): vermilion cord net, two chi-dragon heads holding red silk tassels, with a beast face in the center, vermilion-lacquered handle, gold-copper fittings.

translations.idiomatic: The feihuang flag had a red body and vermilion flame-shaped foot, horse-shaped and yellow with two wings.

sentences.zh: 騼蜀旗，青質，青火焰腳，繪獸形如馬，白首，虎文，赤尾。

translations.literal: Zouwu flag: blue body, blue flame-shaped foot; painted beast shaped like a horse, white head, tiger markings, red tail.
translations.idiomatic: The zouwu flag had a blue body and blue flame-shaped foot, painted with a horse-like beast with white head, tiger markings, and red tail.

sentences.zh: 龍馬旗，赤質，青火焰腳，繪龍馬。

translations.literal: Dragon-horse flag: red body, blue flame-shaped foot; painted with a dragon-horse.
translations.idiomatic: The dragon-horse flag had a red body and blue flame-shaped foot, painted with a dragon-horse.

sentences.zh: 麟旗，赤質，青火焰腳，繪麒麟。

translations.literal: Qilin flag: red body, blue flame-shaped foot; painted with a qilin.
translations.idiomatic: The qilin flag had a red body and blue flame-shaped foot, painted with a qilin.

sentences.zh: 飛麟旗，赤質，青火焰腳，繪飛麟，其形五色身，朱翼，兩角，長爪。

translations.literal: Flying qilin flag: red body, blue flame-shaped foot; painted with a flying qilin, five-colored body, vermilion wings, two horns, long claws.
translations.idiomatic: The flying qilin flag had a red body and blue flame-shaped foot, painted with a flying qilin of five-colored body, vermilion wings, two horns, and long claws.

sentences.zh: 黃鹿旗，赤質，青火焰腳，繪獸如鹿，而色深黃。

translations.literal: Yellow deer flag: red body, blue flame-shaped foot; painted beast like a deer but deep yellow in color.
translations.idiomatic: The yellow deer flag had a red body and blue flame-shaped foot, painted with a deep yellow deer-like beast.

sentences.zh: 兕旗，赤質，青火焰腳，繪獸似牛，一角，青色。

translations.literal: Rhinoceros flag: red body, blue flame-shaped foot; painted beast like an ox, one horn, blue in color.
translations.idiomatic: The rhinoceros flag had a red body and blue flame-shaped foot, painted with a blue one-horned ox-like beast.

sentences.zh: 犀牛旗，赤質，青火焰腳，繪犀牛。

translations.literal: Rhinoceros flag: red body, blue flame-shaped foot; painted with a rhinoceros.
translations.idiomatic: The rhinoceros flag had a red body and blue flame-shaped foot, painted with a rhinoceros.

sentences.zh: 金牛旗，赤質，青火焰腳，繪獸形如牛，金色。

translations.literal: Golden ox flag: red body, blue flame-shaped foot; painted beast shaped like an ox, golden in color.
translations.idiomatic: The golden ox flag had a red body and blue flame-shaped foot, painted with a golden ox-shaped beast.

sentences.zh: 白狼旗，赤質，青火焰腳，繪白狼。

translations.literal: White wolf flag: red body, blue flame-shaped foot; painted with a white wolf.
translations.idiomatic: The white wolf flag had a red body and blue flame-shaped foot, painted with a white wolf.

sentences.zh: 辟邪旗，赤質，赤火焰腳，繪獸形似鹿，長尾，二角。

translations.literal: Ward-off-evil flag: red body, vermilion flame-shaped foot; painted beast like a deer, long tail, two horns.
translations.idiomatic: The ward-off-evil flag had a red body and vermilion flame-shaped foot, painted with a deer-like beast bearing a long tail and two horns.

sentences.zh: 赤熊旗，赤質，赤火焰腳，繪獸如熊，色黃。

translations.literal: Red bear flag: red body, vermilion flame-shaped foot; painted beast like a bear, yellow in color.
translations.idiomatic: The red bear flag had a red body and vermilion flame-shaped foot, painted with a yellow bear-like beast.

sentences.zh: 三角獸旗，赤質，赤火焰腳，繪獸，其首類白澤，綠髮，三角，青質，白腹，跋尾綠色。

translations.literal: Three-horned beast flag: red body, vermilion flame-shaped foot; painted beast whose head resembled a baize, green hair, three horns, blue body, white belly, green tail.
translations.idiomatic: The three-horned beast flag had a red body and vermilion flame-shaped foot, painted with a beast whose head resembled a baize—green-haired, three-horned, blue-bodied, white-bellied, with a green tail.

sentences.zh: 角端旗，赤質，赤火焰腳，繪獸如羊而小尾，頂有獨角。

translations.literal: Jiaoduan flag: red body, vermilion flame-shaped foot; painted beast like a sheep with small tail, a single horn on the crown.
translations.idiomatic: The jiaoduan flag had a red body and vermilion flame-shaped foot, painted with a sheep-like beast with small tail and a single horn atop its crown.

sentences.zh: 騶牙旗，赤質，青火焰腳，繪獸形似麋，齒前後一齊。

translations.literal: Zouya flag: red body, blue flame-shaped foot; painted beast like an elk, teeth aligned front and back.
translations.idiomatic: The zouya flag had a red body and blue flame-shaped foot, painted with an elk-like beast whose teeth stood evenly fore and aft.

sentences.zh: 太平旗，赤質，青火焰腳，金描蓮花四，上金書天下太平字。

translations.literal: Taiping flag: red body, blue flame-shaped foot; four gold lotuses depicted, with gold characters reading All Under Heaven at Peace.
translations.idiomatic: The Taiping flag had a red body and blue flame-shaped foot, bearing four gold lotuses and gold characters proclaiming All Under Heaven at Peace.

sentences.zh: 躭鸃旗，赤質，青火焰腳，繪鳥似山雞而小，冠背黃，腹赤，項綠，尾紅。

translations.literal: Danzhi flag: red body, blue flame-shaped foot; painted bird like a small pheasant, yellow crown and back, yellow belly, red tail, green nape.
translations.idiomatic: The danzhi flag had a red body and blue flame-shaped foot, painted with a small pheasant-like bird—yellow crown and back, yellow belly, red tail, and green nape.

sentences.zh: 蒼烏旗，赤質，青火焰腳，繪鳥如烏而色蒼。

translations.literal: Dark crow flag: red body, blue flame-shaped foot; painted bird like a crow, dark in color.
translations.idiomatic: The dark crow flag had a red body and blue flame-shaped foot, painted with a dark crow-like bird.

sentences.zh: 白澤旗，赤質，赤火焰腳，繪獸虎首朱發而有角，龍身。

translations.literal: Baize flag: red body, vermilion flame-shaped foot; painted beast with tiger head, vermilion hair and horns, dragon body.
translations.idiomatic: The baize flag had a red body and vermilion flame-shaped foot, painted with a horned beast of tiger head, vermilion mane, and dragon body.

sentences.zh: 東方神旗，綠質，赤火焰腳，繪神人，金兜牟，金鎧甲，杖劍。

translations.literal: Eastern Spirit flag: green body, vermilion flame-shaped foot; painted divine figure with gold helmet, gold armor, and sword.
translations.idiomatic: The Eastern Spirit flag had a green body and vermilion flame-shaped foot, depicting a divine figure in gold helmet and gold armor bearing a sword.

sentences.zh: （已下四旗，所繪神同。）〉

translations.literal: (The four flags below depict the same divine figure.) )
translations.idiomatic: (The four flags below depict the same divine figure.) )

sentences.zh: 西方神旗，白質，赤火焰腳。

translations.literal: Western Spirit flag: white body, vermilion flame-shaped foot.
translations.idiomatic: The Western Spirit flag had a white body and vermilion flame-shaped foot.

sentences.zh: 中央神旗，黃質，赤火焰腳。

translations.literal: Central Spirit flag: yellow body, vermilion flame-shaped foot.
translations.idiomatic: The Central Spirit flag had a yellow body and vermilion flame-shaped foot.

sentences.zh: 南方神旗，赤質，青火焰腳。

translations.literal: Southern Spirit flag: red body, blue flame-shaped foot.
translations.idiomatic: The Southern Spirit flag had a red body and blue flame-shaped foot.

sentences.zh: 北方神旗，黑質，赤火焰腳。

translations.literal: Northern Spirit flag: black body, vermilion flame-shaped foot.
translations.idiomatic: The Northern Spirit flag had a black body and vermilion flame-shaped foot.

sentences.zh: 凡立仗諸旗，各火焰腳三條，色與質同，長一丈五尺，杠長二丈一尺。

translations.literal: All standing-ceremony flags each had three flame-shaped feet matching the body color, one zhang five chi in length, with poles two zhang one chi long.
translations.idiomatic: Every standing-ceremony flag bore three flame-shaped feet the color of its body, each foot one zhang five chi long, on a pole two zhang one chi in length.

sentences.zh: 牙門、太平、萬歲，質長一丈，橫闊五尺。

translations.literal: Gate Teeth, Taiping, and Ten Thousand Years flags: body one zhang long, width five chi.
translations.idiomatic: The Gate Teeth, Taiping, and Ten Thousand Years flags measured one zhang in length and five chi in width.

sentences.zh: 日、月、龍君、虎君，橫豎並八尺。

translations.literal: Sun, Moon, Dragon Lord, and Tiger Lord flags: width and height both eight chi.
translations.idiomatic: The Sun, Moon, Dragon Lord, and Tiger Lord flags were each eight chi wide and eight chi tall.

sentences.zh: 余旗並豎長八尺，橫闊六尺。

translations.literal: All other flags were eight chi tall vertically and six chi wide.
translations.idiomatic: All remaining flags stood eight chi high and spanned six chi in width.

sentences.zh: 車輻，朱漆，八棱，施以銅釘，形如柯舒。

translations.literal: Wheel spokes were vermilion lacquer, eight-sided, fitted with copper nails shaped like spreading branches.
translations.idiomatic: The wheel spokes were lacquered vermilion and eight-sided, set with copper nails shaped like spreading branches.

sentences.zh: 吾杖，朱漆，金飾兩末。

translations.literal: Wu staff: vermilion lacquer, gold at both ends.
translations.idiomatic: The wu staff was lacquered vermilion with gold fittings at both ends.

sentences.zh: 鐙杖，朱漆棒首，標以金塗馬鐙。

translations.literal: Stirrup staff: vermilion lacquer at the head, marked with a gold-gilt stirrup.
translations.idiomatic: The stirrup staff had a vermilion-lacquered head bearing a gold-gilt stirrup emblem.

sentences.zh: 殳，制如槊而短，黑飾兩末，中畫雲氣，上綴朱絲拂。

translations.literal: Shu: shaped like a spear but short, black at both ends with cloud patterns in the center, vermilion silk tassel above.
translations.idiomatic: The shu resembled a short spear, black at both ends with cloud patterns amidships and a vermilion silk tassel above.

sentences.zh: 骨朵，朱漆棒首，貫以金塗銅錘。

translations.literal: Guduo: vermilion lacquer at the head, threaded through with a gold-gilt copper hammer.
translations.idiomatic: The guduo bore a vermilion-lacquered head through which ran a gold-gilt copper hammer.

sentences.zh: 列絲骨朵，制如骨朵，加紐絲丈。

translations.literal: Lied-silk guduo: like the guduo, with an added silk cord one zhang long.
translations.idiomatic: The lied-silk guduo matched the guduo but added a silk cord one zhang in length.

sentences.zh: 臥瓜，制形如瓜，塗以黃金，臥置，朱漆棒首。

translations.literal: Reclining melon: melon-shaped, gold-gilt, reclining; vermilion lacquer at the head.
translations.idiomatic: The reclining melon was melon-shaped and gold-gilt, set reclining on a vermilion-lacquered staff head.

sentences.zh: 立瓜，制形如瓜，塗以黃金，立置，朱漆棒首。

translations.literal: Standing melon: melon-shaped, gold-gilt, standing upright; vermilion lacquer at the head.
translations.idiomatic: The standing melon was melon-shaped and gold-gilt, set upright on a vermilion-lacquered staff head.

sentences.zh: 長刀，長丈有奇，闊上窄下，單刃。

translations.literal: Long saber: over one zhang in length, narrow below and broad above, single-edged.
translations.idiomatic: The long saber measured more than one zhang, broad above and narrow below, with a single edge.

sentences.zh: 儀刀，制以銀，飾紫絲分錔。

translations.literal: Ceremonial saber: made of silver, wrapped in purple silk.
translations.idiomatic: The ceremonial saber was wrought in silver and wrapped in purple silk.

sentences.zh: 橫刀，制如儀刀而曲，鞘以沙魚皮，飾鞗革分錔。

translations.literal: Horizontal saber: curved like the ceremonial saber, sheath of sharkskin, leather wrapping.
translations.idiomatic: The horizontal saber curved like the ceremonial saber, with sharkskin sheath and leather bindings.

sentences.zh: 千牛刀，制如長刀。

translations.literal: Thousand-Ox saber: like the long saber.
translations.idiomatic: The Thousand-Ox saber was made like the long saber.

sentences.zh: 劍，班鞘，飾以沙魚皮，劍口兩刃。

translations.literal: Sword: patterned sheath of sharkskin, double-edged blade.
translations.idiomatic: The sword had a patterned sharkskin sheath and a double-edged blade.

sentences.zh: 班劍，制劍，鞘黃質，紫班文，金銅裝，紫絲分錔。

translations.literal: Patterned sword: yellow sheath with purple pattern, gold-copper fittings, purple silk.
translations.idiomatic: The patterned sword bore a yellow sheath with purple designs, gold-copper fittings, and purple silk bindings.

sentences.zh: 刀盾之刀，制如長刀而柄短，木為之，青質有環，紫絲分錔。

translations.literal: Saber-shield saber: like the long saber but short-handled, wood with green ring, purple silk.
translations.idiomatic: The saber-shield saber resembled the long saber with a short wooden handle, green ring, and purple silk wrapping.

sentences.zh: 刀盾之盾，制以木，赤質，畫異獸，執人右刀左盾。

translations.literal: Saber-shield shield: wood, red-painted strange beast; bearer carried saber in the right hand and shield in the left.
translations.idiomatic: The saber-shield shield was wooden, painted red with a strange beast; the bearer held the saber in the right hand and the shield in the left.

sentences.zh: 朱縢絡盾，制同而朱其質。

translations.literal: Vermilion-cord shield: the same, but with vermilion cord.
translations.idiomatic: The vermilion-cord shield was the same, save for its vermilion cord.

sentences.zh: 綠縢絡盾，制同而綠其質。

translations.literal: Green-cord shield: the same, but with green cord.
translations.idiomatic: The green-cord shield was the same, save for its green cord.

sentences.zh: 戟，制以木，有枝，塗以黃金，竿以朱漆。

translations.literal: Halberd: wood with branches, gold-gilt vermilion pole.
translations.idiomatic: The halberd had a branched wooden head on a gold-gilt vermilion pole.

sentences.zh: 小戟飛龍掌，制如戟，畫雲氣，上綴飛掌，垂五色帶，末有銅鈴，掌下方而上兩角微撱，繪龍於其上。

translations.literal: Small halberd with flying-dragon palm: like the halberd with cloud patterns; flying palm, five-color belt, copper bell; palm narrow above, two horns slightly curved, dragon painted.
translations.idiomatic: The small halberd with flying-dragon palm resembled the halberd amid cloud patterns, bearing a flying palm, five-color belt, and copper bell—narrow above, slightly curved twin horns, painted with a dragon.

sentences.zh: 钑戟，制如戟，無飛掌而有橫木。

translations.literal: Sa halberd: like the halberd but without the flying palm, with cross timber instead.
translations.idiomatic: The sa halberd matched the halberd but lacked the flying palm, bearing cross timber in its place.

sentences.zh: 槊，制以木，黑質，畫雲氣，上刻刃，塗以青，五色槊並同而質異。

translations.literal: Spear: wooden, black with cloud patterns; blade above green; five-color spears of the same form in different colors.
translations.idiomatic: The spear was wooden and black with cloud patterns, its blade green above; spears of the same form came in five colors.

sentences.zh: 䂎，制如戟，鋒兩旁微起，下有钅尊銳。

translations.literal: Mang halberd: like the halberd, blades slightly raised below, sharp metal base.
translations.idiomatic: The mang halberd resembled the halberd, its blades slightly raised below with a sharp metal base.

sentences.zh: 叉，制如戟而短，青飾兩末，中白，畫雲氣，上綴紅絲拂。

translations.literal: Fork: like the halberd, short green ends, white center with cloud patterns, red silk tassel.
translations.idiomatic: The fork resembled the halberd, short with green ends, a white center bearing cloud patterns, and a red silk tassel.

sentences.zh: 斧，雙刃，斧貫於朱漆竿首。

translations.literal: Axe: double blade on a vermilion-lacquered pole head.
translations.idiomatic: The axe bore twin blades on a vermilion-lacquered pole head.

sentences.zh: 鉞，金塗鐵鉞，單刃，腦後系朱拂，朱漆竿。

translations.literal: Battle-axe: gold-gilt iron, single blade, red tassel behind, vermilion pole.
translations.idiomatic: The battle-axe was iron with gold-gilt fittings, single-bladed, red tassel to the rear, on a vermilion pole.

sentences.zh: 劈正斧，制以玉，單刃，金塗柄，銀钅尊。

translations.literal: Cleaving axe: jade, single blade, gold handle, silver base.
translations.idiomatic: The cleaving axe was jade, single-bladed, with gold handle and silver base.

sentences.zh: 儀锽斧，制如斧，刻木為之，柄以朱，上綴小錦幡，五色帶。

translations.literal: Ceremonial huang axe: like the axe, carved wood, vermilion handle, small brocade pennant, five-color belt.
translations.idiomatic: The ceremonial huang axe resembled the axe, of carved wood with vermilion handle, small brocade pennant, and five-color belt.

sentences.zh: 弓矢。

translations.literal: Bows and arrows.
translations.idiomatic: Bows and arrows.

sentences.zh: 弩，制如弓而有臂。

translations.literal: Crossbow: like a bow but with an arm.
translations.idiomatic: The crossbow was shaped like a bow fitted with a stock and arm.

sentences.zh: 服，制以虎豹皮，或暴綠文，金銅裝。

translations.literal: Quiver: tiger or leopard skin, or green pattern, with gold-copper fittings.
translations.idiomatic: The quiver was made of tiger or leopard skin, or of green-patterned material, with gold-copper fittings.

sentences.zh: 靫，制以黑革。

translations.literal: Scabbard: black leather.
translations.idiomatic: The scabbard was of black leather.

sentences.zh: 蘭，弩矢室。

translations.literal: Quiver case for crossbow bolts.
translations.idiomatic: The quiver case held crossbow bolts.

sentences.zh: 象韝鞍，五采裝明金木蓮花座，緋繡攀鞍絳，紫繡襜襦紅錦屜，鍮石蓮花跋塵，錦緣氈盤，紅犛牛尾纓拂，並胸攀鞦。

translations.literal: Elephant howdah saddle: five-color fittings, bright gold lotus seat, crimson embroidered climbing saddle, purple embroidered jacket, red brocade leggings, gilt lotus dust-flap, brocade rim, felt mat, red yak-tail tassel, chest and rear straps.
translations.idiomatic: The elephant howdah saddle bore five-color trappings and a bright gold lotus seat, with crimson embroidered climbing saddle, purple embroidered jacket, red brocade leggings, gilt lotus dust-flap, brocade border, felt mat, and red yak-tail tassels on chest and rear straps.

sentences.zh: 攀上各帶紅犛牛尾纓拂，鍮石胡桃鈸子，杏葉鉸具，緋皮轡頭鉸具。

translations.literal: Each climbing strap bore a red yak-tail tassel, gilt walnut plaques, apricot-leaf fittings, and crimson bridle fittings.
translations.idiomatic: On each climbing strap hung a red yak-tail tassel, gilt walnut plaques, apricot-leaf fittings, and crimson bridle hardware.

sentences.zh: 蓮花座上，金塗銀香爐一。

translations.literal: On the lotus seat stood one gold-gilt silver censer.
translations.idiomatic: Upon the lotus seat stood a single gold-gilt silver censer.

sentences.zh: 元初，既定占城、交趾、真臘，歲貢象，育於析津坊海子之陽。

translations.literal: At the founding, after Champa, Jiaozhi, and Zhenla were secured, elephants were submitted yearly and raised south of the haizi at Xijinfang.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the dynasty, once Champa, Jiaozhi, and Zhenla had been brought to heel, elephants were sent as annual tribute and reared on the south shore of the haizi at Xijinfang.

sentences.zh: 行幸則蕃官騎引，以導大駕，以駕巨輦。

translations.literal: On imperial tours, frontier officials rode them as guides, leading the great procession and drawing the great carriage.
translations.idiomatic: On imperial tours, frontier officials rode the elephants as guides, leading the great procession and drawing the great carriage.

sentences.zh: 駝鼓，設金裝鉸具，花罽鞍褥橐篋，前峰樹皂纛，或施采旗，後峰樹小旗，絡腦、當胸、後鞦，並以毛組為轡勒，五色瓘玉，毛結纓絡，周綴銅鐸小鏡，上施一面有底銅小鼓，一人乘之，系以毛繩。

translations.literal: Camel drum: gold fittings, flowered felt saddle case, black standard or colored flag on the front hump, small flag on the rear brain, chest and rear straps, fur reins, five-color jade fur tassels, copper bells and mirrors, one copper drum with base on top, one rider, rope of fur.
translations.idiomatic: The camel drum bore gold fittings and a flowered felt saddle case, a black standard or colored flag on the fore hump and a small flag at the rear brain, with chest and rear straps, fur reins, five-color jade fur tassels, copper bells and mirrors, a rider, and a fur rope—above all, a copper drum with base.

sentences.zh: 凡行幸，先鳴鼓於駝，以威振遠邇，亦以試橋梁伏水而次象焉。

translations.literal: On tour, drums on camels sounded first to awe near and far, also to test bridges and hidden water before the elephants.
translations.idiomatic: On tour the camel drums sounded first to awe those near and far and to test bridges and concealed waters before the elephants followed.

sentences.zh: 騾鼓，制似駝而小。

translations.literal: Mule drum: like the camel drum but smaller.
translations.idiomatic: The mule drum matched the camel drum in form but was smaller.

sentences.zh: 馬鼓，轡勒、後勒、當胸，皆綴紅纓拂銅鈴，杏葉鉸具，金塗頠，上插雉尾，上負四足小架，上施以華鼓一面，一人前引。

translations.literal: Horse drum: bridle, rear breast strap, and chest strap each bore red tassel, copper bell, apricot fittings, gold-gilt brow, pheasant tail; a four-legged frame above bore one ceremonial drum; one man led ahead.
translations.idiomatic: The horse drum hung from bridle, rear breast, and chest straps adorned with red tassels, copper bells, apricot fittings, gold-gilt brow, and pheasant tail; a four-legged frame above carried a ceremonial drum, with one man leading ahead.

sentences.zh: 凡行幸，負鼓於馬以先馳，與纛並行。

translations.literal: On tour, the drum borne on the horse galloped ahead alongside the standard.
translations.idiomatic: On tour the horse-borne drum galloped ahead in company with the standard.

sentences.zh: 誕馬，纓轡緋涼銕。

translations.literal: Tribute horse: crimson bridle.
translations.idiomatic: The tribute horse wore a crimson bridle.

sentences.zh: 御馬，鞍轡纓復全。

translations.literal: Imperial horse: full saddle and trappings.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial horse bore complete saddle and trappings.

sentences.zh: 珂馬，銅面，雉尾鼻拂，胸上綴銅杏葉、紅絲拂，又胸前腹下，皆有攀，綴銅鈴，後有跋塵，錦包尾。

translations.literal: Ke horse: copper face plate, pheasant-tail nose tassel, apricot leaf on chest, red silk tassel, climbing fittings on chest and belly with copper bells, rear dust-flap, brocade tail wrap.
translations.idiomatic: The ke horse wore a copper face plate and pheasant-tail nose tassel, apricot leaf and red silk tassel on the chest, climbing fittings on chest and belly hung with copper bells, plus rear dust-flap and brocade-wrapped tail.

sentences.zh: 崇天鹵簿中道。

translations.literal: Supremely Heaven regalia: central path.
translations.idiomatic: The Supremely Heaven regalia procession took the central path.

sentences.zh: 頓遞隊：象六，飾以金裝蓮座，香寶鞍韂鞦轡罽勒，犛牛尾拂，跋塵，鉸具。

translations.literal: Relay team: six elephants with gold lotus seat, incense treasure, saddle, trappings, yak-tail dust-flap, and fittings.
translations.idiomatic: The relay team comprised six elephants adorned with gold lotus seats, incense treasure, saddles, trappings, yak-tail dust-flaps, and fittings.

sentences.zh: 導者六人，馭者南越軍六人，皆弓花角唐帽，緋絁銷金衤癸衫，鍍金束帶，烏靴，橫列而前行。

translations.literal: Six guides and six Nanyue army drivers, flower-horn Tang hats, crimson brocade jackets, gilt belts, black boots, advancing crosswise ahead.
translations.idiomatic: Six guides and six drivers from the Nanyue army, in flower-horn Tang hats, crimson brocade jackets, gilt belts, and black boots, advanced crosswise at the fore.

sentences.zh: 次駝鼓九，飾以鍍金鉸具，轡飾罽籠旗鼓纓槍。

translations.literal: Next, nine camel drums with gilt fittings, felt cage, flags, spears, and tassels.
translations.idiomatic: Next came nine camel drums with gilt fittings, felt cages, flags, spears, and tassels.

sentences.zh: 馭者九人，服同馭象者，中道相次而行。

translations.literal: Nine drivers dressed like the elephant drivers, proceeding in file along the central path.
translations.idiomatic: Nine drivers in the same dress as the elephant drivers followed in file along the central path.

sentences.zh: 次舍人二人，四品服，騎分左右，夾駝而行。

translations.literal: Next, two Gentlemen of the Palace of fourth rank on horseback, flanking the camels left and right.
translations.idiomatic: Next rode two Gentlemen of the Palace of fourth rank on horseback, flanking the camels to left and right.

sentences.zh: 次青衣一人，武弁，青絁衫，青勒帛，青靴，執青杖。

translations.literal: Next, one green-robed attendant in martial cap, green robe, green belt, green boots, holding a green staff.
translations.idiomatic: Next came one green-robed attendant in martial cap, green robe, green belt, and green boots, bearing a green staff.

sentences.zh: 次清道官四人，本品服，騎。

translations.literal: Next, four clear-path officials in rank dress on horseback.
translations.idiomatic: Next rode four clear-path officials in their proper rank dress.

sentences.zh: 次信幡二，執者二人，引護者四人，武弁，黃絁生色寶相花袍，黃勒帛，黃靴。

translations.literal: Next, two trust pennants with two bearers and four escorts in martial cap, yellow brocade robe, yellow belt, yellow boots.
translations.idiomatic: Next came two trust pennants, each with two bearers and four escorts in martial cap, yellow brocade robe, yellow belt, and yellow boots.

sentences.zh: 次騾鼓六，飾騾以鍍金鉸具，轡罽籠旗鼓纓槍。

translations.literal: Next, six mule drums on mules with gilt fittings, felt cage, flags, and spears.
translations.idiomatic: Next followed six mule drums on mules with gilt fittings, felt cages, flags, and spears.

sentences.zh: 馭者六人，服同馭駝者。

translations.literal: Six drivers dressed like the camel drivers.
translations.idiomatic: Six drivers wore the same dress as the camel drivers.

sentences.zh: 次告止幡二，執者二人，引護者四人，武弁，緋絁生色寶相花袍，紅勒帛，紅靴。

translations.literal: Next, two stop pennants with two bearers and four escorts in martial cap, crimson brocade robe, red belt, red boots.
translations.idiomatic: Next came two stop pennants, each with two bearers and four escorts in martial cap, crimson brocade robe, red belt, and red boots.

sentences.zh: 次傳教幡二，執者二人，引護者四人，武弁，黃絁生色寶相花袍，黃勒帛，黃靴，並分左右。

translations.literal: Next, two transmit-teaching pennants of the same pattern in yellow brocade, left and right.
translations.idiomatic: Next came two transmit-teaching pennants of the same pattern in yellow brocade, one to the left and one to the right.

sentences.zh: 次橋道頓遞使一人，本品服，騎。

translations.literal: Next, one bridge relay envoy in rank dress on horseback.
translations.idiomatic: Next rode one bridge relay envoy in his proper rank dress.

sentences.zh: 中道，舍人、清道官、橋道頓遞使從者凡七人，錦帽，紫衤癸衫，小銀束帶，行縢鞋襪。

translations.literal: Along the central path, seven attendants for the Gentlemen, clear-path officials, and bridge envoy: brocade hat, purple jacket, small silver belt, gaiters, socks, and shoes.
translations.idiomatic: Along the central path walked seven attendants for the Gentlemen, clear-path officials, and bridge envoy in brocade hats, purple jackets, small silver belts, gaiters, socks, and shoes.

sentences.zh: （後凡從者之服，皆同此。）〉

translations.literal: (Hereafter attendants' dress is the same.) )
translations.idiomatic: (Hereafter attendants' dress is the same.) )

sentences.zh: 纛槊隊：金吾將軍二人，交角襆頭，緋羅繡抹額，紫羅繡辟邪裲襠，紅錦襯袍，錦丱蛇，金帶，烏靴，橫刀，佩符，騎，分左右。

translations.literal: Standard-spear company: two Golden Guard generals in crossed-corner headwrap, crimson embroidered forehead band, purple embroidered ward-off-evil cross-collar, red brocade lining, brocade serpent, gold belt, black boots, horizontal saber, tally token on horseback, left and right.
translations.idiomatic: The standard-spear company placed two Golden Guard generals on horseback to left and right, in crossed-corner headwraps, crimson embroidered forehead bands, purple embroidered ward-off-evil cross-collars over red brocade linings, brocade serpents, gold belts, black boots, horizontal sabers, and tally tokens at the belt.

sentences.zh: 次弩而騎者五人，錦帽，青絁生色寶相花袍，銅帶，綠雲靴。

translations.literal: Next, five archers on horseback in brocade hat, blue brocade robe, copper belt, green cloud boots.
translations.idiomatic: Next rode five archers in brocade hats, blue brocade robes, copper belts, and green cloud boots.

sentences.zh: 次槊而騎者五人，錦帽，緋絁生色寶相花袍，銅帶，朱雲靴。

translations.literal: Next, five spearmen on horseback in brocade hat, crimson brocade robe, copper belt, vermilion cloud boots.
translations.idiomatic: Next rode five spearmen in brocade hats, crimson brocade robes, copper belts, and vermilion cloud boots.

sentences.zh: 次纛一，執者一人，夾者四人，護者二人，皆錦帽，紫生色寶相花袍，鍍金帶，紫雲靴。

translations.literal: Next, one standard with one bearer, four flanking, two guards—all in brocade hat, purple brocade, gilt belt, purple cloud boots.
translations.idiomatic: Next came one standard with one bearer, four flanking men, and two guards, all in brocade hats, purple brocade, gilt belts, and purple cloud boots.

sentences.zh: 押纛官二人，皆騎，本品服。

translations.literal: Two standard escort officers on horseback in rank dress.
translations.idiomatic: Two standard escort officers rode in their proper rank dress.

sentences.zh: 次馬鼓四，飾如騾鼓，馭者四人，服同禦騾。

translations.literal: Next, four horse drums like the mule drums; four drivers dressed like the mule drivers.
translations.idiomatic: Next followed four horse drums matching the mule drums, with four drivers in the same dress as the mule drivers.

sentences.zh: 次佩弓矢而騎者五人，服同執弩者。

translations.literal: Next, five bow-and-arrow horsemen dressed like the archers.
translations.idiomatic: Next rode five bow-and-arrow horsemen dressed like the archers.

sentences.zh: 押衙四人，騎而佩劍，錦帽，紫絁生色寶相花袍，鍍金帶，雲頭靴，槊者四人，騎，錦帽，緋絁生色寶相花袍，銅帶，朱靴。

translations.literal: Four yamen press officers on horseback with sword, brocade hat, purple brocade, gilt belt, cloud-toe boots; four spear-bearers on horseback in brocade hat, crimson brocade, copper belt, vermilion boots.
translations.idiomatic: Four yamen press officers rode with swords, brocade hats, purple brocade, gilt belts, and cloud-toe boots; four spear-bearers followed on horseback in brocade hats, crimson brocade, copper belts, and vermilion boots.

sentences.zh: 控馬八人，錦帽，紫衫，銀帶，烏靴。

translations.literal: Eight horse handlers in brocade hat, purple robe, silver belt, black boots.
translations.idiomatic: Eight horse handlers wore brocade hats, purple robes, silver belts, and black boots.

sentences.zh: 次槊而騎者五人，服佩同執弩者。

translations.literal: Next, five more spearmen dressed and armed like the archers.
translations.idiomatic: Next rode five more spearmen dressed and armed like the archers.

sentences.zh: 金吾將軍、押纛官從者四人，服同前隊。

translations.literal: Golden Guard generals, standard escorts, four attendants—same as the prior company.
translations.idiomatic: The Golden Guard generals, standard escorts, and four attendants matched the prior company in dress.

sentences.zh: 朱雀隊：舍人一人，四品服，騎而前。

translations.literal: Vermilion Bird company: one Gentleman of fourth rank rides ahead.
translations.idiomatic: In the Vermilion Bird company, one Gentleman of fourth rank rode at the fore.

sentences.zh: 次朱雀旗一，執者一人，引護者四人，錦帽，緋絁生色鳳花袍，銅帶，朱雲靴，皆佩劍而騎，護者加弓矢。

translations.literal: Next, one Vermilion Bird flag with one bearer and four escorts in brocade hat, crimson brocade phoenix robe, copper belt, vermilion cloud boots—all sword on horseback; escorts also bore bow and arrow.
translations.idiomatic: Next came one Vermilion Bird flag with one bearer and four escorts in brocade hats, crimson brocade phoenix robes, copper belts, and vermilion cloud boots, all sword-armed on horseback; the escorts also carried bow and arrow.

sentences.zh: 次金吾折沖一人，交角襆頭，緋絁繡抹額，紫羅繡辟邪裲襠，紅錦襯袍，金帶，錦螣蛇，烏靴，橫刀，佩弓矢而騎，帥甲騎凡二十有五，弩五人，次弓五人，次槊五人，次弓五人，次槊五人，皆冠甲騎冠，朱畫甲，青勒甲絳，鍍金環，白繡汗胯，束帶，紅靴，帶弓箭器仗，馬皆朱甲、具裝珂飾全。

translations.literal: Next, one Golden Guard assault vanquisher in crossed headwrap, crimson embroidered forehead band, purple ward-off-evil cross-collar, red brocade lining, gold belt, brocade serpent, black boots, horizontal saber, bow and arrow on horseback, leading twenty-five armored cavalry—five crossbow, then five bow, then five spear, then five bow, then five spear—all armored cavalry caps, vermilion painted armor, blue leather armor, gilt rings, white embroidered sweat-trousers, sash, red boots, full arms; horses all vermilion armor, full barding and ke trappings.
translations.idiomatic: Next rode one Golden Guard assault vanquisher in crossed headwrap, crimson embroidered forehead band, purple ward-off-evil cross-collar over red brocade lining, gold belt, brocade serpent, black boots, horizontal saber, and bow and arrow, leading twenty-five armored horsemen—five crossbowmen, then five bowmen, then five spearmen, then five bowmen, then five spearmen—all in armored cavalry caps, vermilion-painted armor, blue leather armor, gilt rings, white embroidered sweat-trousers, sashes, red boots, and full weaponry; their horses bore vermilion armor and complete barding with ke trappings.

sentences.zh: 舍人、金吾折沖從者凡二人，服同前隊。

translations.literal: Gentleman, Golden Guard assault vanquisher, two attendants—same as the prior company.
translations.idiomatic: The Gentleman, Golden Guard assault vanquisher, and two attendants dressed like the prior company.

sentences.zh: 十二旗隊：舍人一人，四品服，騎而前。

translations.literal: Twelve-flags company: one Gentleman of fourth rank rides ahead.
translations.idiomatic: In the Twelve-flags company, one Gentleman of fourth rank rode at the fore.

sentences.zh: 金吾果毅二人，交角襆頭，緋羅繡抹額，紫羅繡辟邪裲襠，紅錦襯袍，金帶錦丱蛇，烏靴，橫刀，佩弓矢，騎分左右。

translations.literal: Two Golden Guard resolute officers in crossed-corner headwraps, crimson brocade embroidered forehead bands, purple brocade embroidered ward-off-evil cross-collars, red brocade linings, gold belts with brocade serpents, black boots, horizontal sabers, bow and arrow at the belt, on horseback to left and right.
translations.idiomatic: Two Golden Guard resolute officers rode to left and right in crossed-corner headwraps, crimson brocade embroidered forehead bands, purple brocade embroidered ward-off-evil cross-collars over red brocade linings, gold belts with brocade serpents, black boots, horizontal sabers, and bow and arrow at the belt.

sentences.zh: 帥引旗騎士五，皆錦帽，黃生色寶相花袍，銀帶，烏靴。

translations.literal: Five lead-banner horsemen, all in brocade hats, yellow fresh-color treasure-flower robes, silver belts, black boots.
translations.idiomatic: Five lead-banner horsemen all wore brocade hats, yellow fresh-color treasure-flower robes, silver belts, and black boots.

sentences.zh: 次風伯旗左，雨師旗右，雷公旗左，電母旗右，執者四人，騎，青甲騎冠，綠甲，青勒甲絳，鍍金環，白繡汗胯，束帶，青雲靴，馬皆青甲珂飾。

translations.literal: Next, Wind Lord flag left, Rain Master flag right, Thunder Lord flag left, Lightning Mother flag right; four bearers on horseback in blue armored cavalry caps, green armor, blue leather armor, gilt rings, white embroidered sweat-trousers, sashes, blue cloud boots; horses all in blue armor with ke trappings.
translations.idiomatic: Next came the Wind Lord flag to the left and Rain Master flag to the right, Thunder Lord flag to the left and Lightning Mother flag to the right, borne by four horsemen in blue armored cavalry caps, green armor, blue leather armor, gilt rings, white embroidered sweat-trousers, sashes, and blue cloud boots; their horses wore blue armor with ke trappings.

sentences.zh: 次五星旗五，執者五人，甲騎冠，五色畫甲，青勒甲絳，鍍金環，白繡汗胯，束帶，五色靴，馬甲如其甲之色，珂飾。

translations.literal: Next, five Five Stars flags with five bearers in armored cavalry caps, five-colored painted armor, blue leather armor, gilt rings, white embroidered sweat-trousers, sashes, five-colored boots; horse armor matched armor color, ke trappings.
translations.idiomatic: Next came five Five Stars flags with five bearers in armored cavalry caps, five-colored painted armor, blue leather armor, gilt rings, white embroidered sweat-trousers, sashes, and five-colored boots; their horses bore armor in matching colors with ke trappings.

sentences.zh: 次北斗旗一，執者一人，甲騎冠，紫畫甲，青勒甲絳，鍍金環，白繡汗胯，束帶，紫雲靴，馬甲隨其甲之色，珂飾。

translations.literal: Next, one Northern Dipper flag with one bearer in armored cavalry cap, purple painted armor, blue leather armor, gilt ring, white embroidered sweat-trousers, sash, purple cloud boots; horse armor followed armor color, ke trappings.
translations.idiomatic: Next came one Northern Dipper flag with one bearer in an armored cavalry cap, purple painted armor, blue leather armor, a gilt ring, white embroidered sweat-trousers, sash, and purple cloud boots; the horse bore matching purple armor with ke trappings.

sentences.zh: 左右攝提旗二，執者二人，甲騎冠，朱畫甲，青勒甲絳，鍍金環，白繡汗胯，束帶，紅雲靴，馬朱甲，珂飾。

translations.literal: Left and right, two Sheti flags with two bearers in armored cavalry caps, vermilion painted armor, blue leather armor, gilt rings, white embroidered sweat-trousers, sashes, red cloud boots; horses vermilion armor, ke trappings.
translations.idiomatic: To left and right came two Sheti flags with two bearers in armored cavalry caps, vermilion painted armor, blue leather armor, gilt rings, white embroidered sweat-trousers, sashes, and red cloud boots; their horses wore vermilion armor with ke trappings.

sentences.zh: 執副竿者二人，騎，錦帽，黃生色寶相花袍，銀帶，烏靴。

translations.literal: Two secondary-pole bearers on horseback in brocade hats, yellow fresh-color treasure-flower robes, silver belts, black boots.
translations.idiomatic: Two secondary-pole bearers rode in brocade hats, yellow fresh-color treasure-flower robes, silver belts, and black boots.

sentences.zh: 執槊而護者五人，騎，服同執副竿者。

translations.literal: Five spear-bearing escorts on horseback, dress like the secondary-pole bearers.
translations.idiomatic: Five spear-bearing escorts rode in the same dress as the secondary-pole bearers.

sentences.zh: 舍人、金吾果毅從者凡三人，服同前隊。

translations.literal: Gentlemen of the Palace and Golden Guard resolute officers, three attendants in all, dress same as prior company.
translations.idiomatic: The Gentlemen of the Palace, Golden Guard resolute officers, and three attendants dressed like the prior company.

sentences.zh: 門旗隊：舍人二人，四品服。

translations.literal: Gate-flag company: two Gentlemen of the Palace in fourth-rank dress.
translations.idiomatic: The gate-flag company had two Gentlemen of the Palace in fourth-rank dress.

sentences.zh: 監門將軍二人，皆交角襆頭，緋絁繡抹額，紫羅繡獅子裲襠，紅錦襯袍，金帶，烏靴，橫刀，佩弓矢，騎，馬甲、珂飾全。

translations.literal: Two gate-guard generals, both in crossed-corner headwraps, crimson silk embroidered forehead bands, purple brocade embroidered lion cross-collars, red brocade linings, gold belts, black boots, horizontal sabers, bow and arrow at belt, on horseback with full horse armor and ke trappings.
translations.idiomatic: Two gate-guard generals rode in crossed-corner headwraps, crimson silk embroidered forehead bands, purple brocade embroidered lion cross-collars over red brocade linings, gold belts, black boots, horizontal sabers, and bow and arrow at the belt, on horses with full armor and ke trappings.

sentences.zh: 次門旗二，執者二人，錦帽，緋絁生色獅子文袍，銅革帶，紅雲靴，劍而騎。

translations.literal: Next, two gate flags with two bearers in brocade hats, crimson silk fresh-color lion-pattern robes, copper-leather belts, red cloud boots, sword on horseback.
translations.idiomatic: Next came two gate flags with two bearers in brocade hats, crimson silk fresh-color lion-pattern robes, copper-leather belts, and red cloud boots, sword-armed on horseback.

sentences.zh: 引護者四人，服佩同執人，而加弓矢，騎。

translations.literal: Four escorts, dress and arms like bearers but with bow and arrow added, on horseback.
translations.idiomatic: Four escorts rode in the bearers' dress and arms with bow and arrow added.

sentences.zh: 次監門校尉二人，騎，服佩同監門將軍，分左右行。

translations.literal: Next, two gate-guard company commanders on horseback, dress and arms like gate-guard generals, marching left and right.
translations.idiomatic: Next rode two gate-guard company commanders in the generals' dress and arms, one column to the left and one to the right.

sentences.zh: 次鸞旗一，執者一人，引護者四人，錦帽，五色絁生色瑞鸞花袍，束帶，五色雲靴，佩劍，護人加弓矢，皆騎。

translations.literal: Next, one imperial phoenix flag with one bearer and four escorts in brocade hats, five-colored silk fresh-color auspicious-phoenix robes, sashes, five-colored cloud boots, swords; escorts also bore bow and arrow, all on horseback.
translations.idiomatic: Next came one imperial phoenix flag with one bearer and four escorts in brocade hats, five-colored silk fresh-color auspicious-phoenix robes, sashes, five-colored cloud boots, and swords; the escorts also carried bow and arrow, all on horseback.

sentences.zh: 舍人、監門將軍、監門校尉從者凡六人，服同前隊。

translations.literal: Gentlemen of the Palace, gate-guard generals, gate-guard company commanders, six attendants in all, dress same as prior company.
translations.idiomatic: The Gentlemen of the Palace, gate-guard generals, gate-guard company commanders, and six attendants dressed like the prior company.

sentences.zh: 雲和樂：雲和署令二人，朝服，騎，分左右。

translations.literal: Yunhe music: two directors of the Yunhe Bureau in court dress on horseback, left and right.
translations.idiomatic: Yunhe music placed two directors of the Yunhe Bureau in court dress on horseback to left and right.

sentences.zh: 引前行，凡十有六人，戲竹二，排簫四，簫管二，龍笛二，板二，歌工四，皆展角花襆頭，紫絁生色雲花袍，鍍金帶，紫靴。

translations.literal: Leading forward, sixteen in all: two theatrical bamboo, four panpipes, two xiao pipes, two dragon flutes, two clappers, four singers—all in spread-corner floral headwraps, purple silk fresh-color cloud-flower robes, gilt belts, purple boots.
translations.idiomatic: Leading forward were sixteen performers in all—two theatrical bamboo, four panpipes, two xiao pipes, two dragon flutes, two clappers, and four singers—all in spread-corner floral headwraps, purple silk fresh-color cloud-flower robes, gilt belts, and purple boots.

sentences.zh: 次琵琶二十，箏十有六，箜篌十有六，緌十有六，方響八，頭管二十有八，龍笛二十有八，已上工百三十有二人，皆花襆頭，緋絁生色雲花袍，鍍金帶，朱靴。

translations.literal: Next, twenty pipa, sixteen zheng, sixteen konghou, sixteen rui, eight fangxiang, twenty-eight touguan, twenty-eight dragon flutes—the musicians above totaling one hundred thirty-two, all in floral headwraps, crimson silk fresh-color cloud-flower robes, gilt belts, vermilion boots.
translations.idiomatic: Next came twenty pipa, sixteen zheng, sixteen konghou, sixteen rui, eight fangxiang, twenty-eight touguan, and twenty-eight dragon flutes—one hundred thirty-two musicians in all—in floral headwraps, crimson silk fresh-color cloud-flower robes, gilt belts, and vermilion boots.

sentences.zh: 次杖鼓三十，工人花襆頭，黃生色花襖，紅生色花袍，錦臂韝，鍍金帶，烏靴。

translations.literal: Next, thirty staff-drums; musicians in floral headwraps, yellow fresh-color floral jackets, red fresh-color floral robes, brocade arm-guards, gilt belts, black boots.
translations.idiomatic: Next followed thirty staff-drums; their musicians wore floral headwraps, yellow fresh-color floral jackets, red fresh-color floral robes, brocade arm-guards, gilt belts, and black boots.

sentences.zh: 次板八，工人服色同琵琶工人。

translations.literal: Next, eight clappers; musicians' dress matched pipa musicians.
translations.idiomatic: Next came eight clappers; their musicians dressed like the pipa musicians.

sentences.zh: 次大鼓二，工十人，服色同杖鼓工人。

translations.literal: Next, two great drums with ten musicians, dress matching staff-drum musicians.
translations.idiomatic: Next came two great drums with ten musicians dressed like the staff-drum musicians.

sentences.zh: 雲和署令從者二人，服同前隊。

translations.literal: Two attendants for the Yunhe Bureau directors, dress same as prior company.
translations.idiomatic: Two attendants for the Yunhe Bureau directors dressed like the prior company.

translations.literal: Crane-Control enclosure company: one enclosure chief bearing a mace along the central path in crossed-corner headwrap, crimson brocade zhisun jacket, gilt lychee belt, saweng shoes.
translations.idiomatic: The Crane-Control enclosure company placed one enclosure chief along the central path bearing a mace in a crossed-corner headwrap, crimson brocade zhisun jacket, gilt lychee belt, and saweng shoes.

sentences.zh: 領執圍子十有六人，分左右，交角金花襆頭，白襯肩，青錦質孫襖，鍍金荔枝帶，翁鞋。

translations.literal: Leading sixteen enclosure bearers left and right in crossed-corner gilt-floral headwraps, white shoulder-linings, blue brocade zhisun jackets, gilt lychee belts, saweng shoes.
translations.idiomatic: He led sixteen enclosure bearers to left and right in crossed-corner gilt-floral headwraps, white shoulder-linings, blue brocade zhisun jackets, gilt lychee belts, and saweng shoes.

translations.literal: Next, vermilion umbrella in the central path; next golden footrest left, golden chair right, dress like the enclosure chief.
translations.idiomatic: Next came a vermilion umbrella along the central path, then a golden footrest to the left and golden chair to the right, borne by men dressed like the enclosure chief.

sentences.zh: 拱衛指揮使一人，本品服，騎，中道。

translations.literal: One Arch-Guard commander in proper rank dress on horseback in the central path.
translations.idiomatic: One Arch-Guard commander rode in his proper rank dress along the central path.

sentences.zh: 控鶴二十人，服同上。

translations.literal: Twenty Crane-Control men, dress as above.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty Crane-Control men wore the same dress as above.

sentences.zh: 拱衛指揮使從者二人，服同前隊。

translations.literal: Two attendants for the Arch-Guard commander, dress same as prior company.
translations.idiomatic: Two attendants for the Arch-Guard commander dressed like the prior company.

sentences.zh: 天樂一部：天樂署令二人，本品服，騎，分左右。

translations.literal: Tian music ensemble: two directors of the Tian Bureau in proper rank dress on horseback, left and right.
translations.idiomatic: The Tian music ensemble placed two directors of the Tian Bureau on horseback in their proper rank dress, to left and right.

sentences.zh: 領押職二人，弓角鳳翅金花襆頭，紅錦質孫襖，加襕，金束帶，花靴。

translations.literal: Leading two performance supervisors in bow-horn phoenix-wing gilt-floral headwraps, red brocade zhisun jackets with layered skirts, gold sashes, floral boots.
translations.idiomatic: Leading them were two performance supervisors in bow-horn phoenix-wing gilt-floral headwraps, red brocade zhisun jackets with layered skirts, gold sashes, and floral boots.

sentences.zh: 次琵琶二，箜篌二，火不思二，板二，箏二，胡琴二，笙二，頭管二，龍笛一，響鐵一，工十有八人，徒二人，皆弓角鳳翅金花襆頭，紅錦質孫襖，鍍金束帶，花靴。

translations.literal: Next, two pipa, two konghou, two huobusi, two clappers, two zheng, two huqin, two sheng, two touguan, one dragon flute, one sounding iron; eighteen musicians and two foot attendants, all in bow-horn phoenix-wing gilt-floral headwraps, red brocade zhisun jackets, gilt sashes, floral boots.

sentences.zh: 控鶴第二隊：僉拱衛司事二人，本品服，騎，分左右。

translations.literal: Crane-Control second company: two Arch-Guard bureau officers in proper rank dress on horseback, left and right.
translations.idiomatic: The Crane-Control second company placed two Arch-Guard bureau officers on horseback in their proper rank dress, to left and right.

sentences.zh: 帥步士凡七十有四人，執立瓜者三十有六人，分左右，次捧金杌一人左，鞭桶一人右，次蒙鞍一人左，傘手一人右，次執立瓜者三十有四人，分左右，皆交角金花襆頭，緋錦質孫襖，鍍金荔枝帶，翁鞋。

translations.literal: Leading seventy-four foot soldiers in all: thirty-six standing-melon bearers left and right; next one bearer of the golden stool left, one whip bucket right; next one saddle-cover bearer left, one umbrella bearer right; next thirty-four standing-melon bearers left and right—all in crossed-corner gilt-floral headwraps, crimson brocade zhisun jackets, gilt lychee belts, saweng shoes.

translations.literal: Two attendants for the Arch-Guard bureau officers, dress same as prior company.
translations.idiomatic: Two attendants for the Arch-Guard bureau officers dressed like the prior company.

sentences.zh: 殿中導從隊：舍人二人，四品服，騎，左右。

translations.literal: Palace guiding escort company: two Gentlemen of the Palace in fourth-rank dress on horseback, left and right.
translations.idiomatic: The palace guiding escort company placed two Gentlemen of the Palace in fourth-rank dress on horseback to left and right.

translations.literal: Leading one incense-lamp table in yellow gilded coiling-dragon drapery with golden censer and box, knotted ribbons, dragon-head pole; twelve bearers in crossed-corner gilt-floral headwraps, red brocade zhisun Crane-Control jackets, gilt sashes, saweng shoes.

sentences.zh: 侍香二人，騎，分左右。

translations.literal: Two incense attendants on horseback, left and right.
translations.idiomatic: Two incense attendants rode to left and right.

sentences.zh: 次警蹕三人，交角襆頭，紫窄袖衫，鍍金束帶，烏靴。

translations.literal: Next, three clearance heralds in crossed-corner headwraps, purple narrow-sleeve robes, gilt sashes, black boots.
translations.idiomatic: Next walked three clearance heralds in crossed-corner headwraps, purple narrow-sleeve robes, gilt sashes, and black boots.

sentences.zh: 次舍人二人，四品服，騎。

translations.literal: Next, two Gentlemen of the Palace in fourth-rank dress on horseback.
translations.idiomatic: Next rode two Gentlemen of the Palace in fourth-rank dress.

translations.literal: Leading two celestial martial officers bearing golden axes, golden phoenix-wing helmets, golden lock armor, blue leather armor, gold rings, brocade embroidered sweat-trousers, gold sashes, horses with ke trappings.
translations.idiomatic: Leading them were two celestial martial officers bearing golden axes in golden phoenix-wing helmets, golden lock armor, blue leather armor, gold rings, brocade embroidered sweat-trousers, and gold sashes, on horses with ke trappings.

translations.literal: Next, two golden maces, next two pennants, next two batons, left and right.
translations.idiomatic: Next came two golden maces, then two pennants, then two batons, to left and right.

translations.idiomatic: Next came a golden water basin to the left and golden chair to the right; next a saddle cover to the left and deputy chair-bearer to the right; next a golden water flask and deer-stand to the left and gilded purifying cloth to the right.

translations.literal: Next, two golden incense balls, two golden incense boxes, left and right.

translations.literal: Next, golden spittoon left, golden spit bowl right.
translations.idiomatic: Next came a golden spittoon to the left and a golden spit bowl to the right.

translations.literal: Four golden fly-whisks, ten fans, left and right.
translations.idiomatic: Four golden fly-whisks and ten fans were placed to left and right.

translations.literal: Next, yellow parasol, central path; parasol-cloth bearers follow.

translations.idiomatic: Thirty mounted knights in all wore dress like the clearance heralds, with white embroidered sweat-trousers added.

sentences.zh: 步卒四人，

translations.literal: Four foot soldiers,
translations.idiomatic: Four foot soldiers

sentences.zh: （執椅二人，蒙復一人，傘衣一人。）〉

translations.literal: (Two chair-bearers, one saddle-cover bearer, and one parasol-cloth bearer.)
translations.idiomatic: (Two chair-bearers, one saddle-cover bearer, and one parasol-cloth bearer.)

sentences.zh: 服如舁香鐙徒。

translations.literal: Dress like the incense-lamp bearers.
translations.idiomatic: Their dress matched the incense-lamp bearers.

translations.literal: Gentlemen of the Palace and celestial martial officer attendants six in all, dress same as prior company.
translations.idiomatic: Six attendants for the Gentlemen of the Palace and celestial martial officers dressed like the prior company.

translations.idiomatic: The Crane-Control third company placed two Arch-Guard straight commanders on horseback in their proper rank dress.

translations.idiomatic: The imperial guidance officers placed two Presentation Commissioners to advance ahead on left and right.

translations.literal: Next, two Commissioners of Ritual Protocol, left and right.
translations.idiomatic: Next came two Commissioners of Ritual Protocol, to left and right.

translations.literal: One bearer of the cleaving axe, central path.

translations.idiomatic: The Forest of Feathers night guard placed two Gentlemen of the Palace in fourth-rank dress to advance ahead.

translations.literal: Gentlemen of the Palace and Forest of Feathers general attendants four in all, dress same as prior company.
translations.idiomatic: Four attendants for the Gentlemen of the Palace and Forest of Feathers generals dressed like the prior company.

translations.idiomatic: Inspection officers:

translations.literal: (Posted outside the central path, within the outer escort.)
translations.idiomatic: (Posted outside the central path, within the outer escort.)

sentences.zh: 頓遞隊，監察御史二人，本品服。

translations.literal: Relay company; two Supervising Censors in proper rank dress.
translations.idiomatic: The relay company had two Supervising Censors in their proper rank dress.

sentences.zh: 次纛槊隊，循仗檢校官二人。

translations.literal: Next, standard-spear company; two procession-inspection officers.
translations.idiomatic: Next came the standard-spear company, with two procession-inspection officers.

sentences.zh: 次十二旗隊，兵部侍郎二人，本品服。

translations.literal: Next, Twelve Banners company; two Vice Ministers of War in proper rank dress.
translations.idiomatic: Next came the Twelve Banners company, with two Vice Ministers of War in their proper rank dress.

sentences.zh: 次門旗隊，糾察儀仗官二人，本品服。

translations.literal: Next, gate-banner company; two ceremonial-weaponry inspection officers in proper rank dress.
translations.idiomatic: Next came the gate-banner company, with two ceremonial-weaponry inspection officers in their proper rank dress.

translations.literal: Two company-escort knowing officers in proper rank dress.
translations.idiomatic: Two company-escort knowing officers in their proper rank dress.

translations.idiomatic: Next came the Martial Guard gilded-halberd company, with two Supervising Censors in their proper rank dress.

translations.literal: Next, palace parasol-and-fan company; two Supervising Censors, next two Ministers of Rites—all in proper rank dress.

translations.idiomatic: Next came the palace guiding escort company, with two ceremonial-weaponry inspection officers.

translations.idiomatic: Next came two patrol-escort inspection officers.

translations.idiomatic: Outside Crane-Control, within the outer escort.
