translations.literal: Front and rear inspection; six duty-knowing officers within the escort in spread-corner headwraps, purple narrow jackets, gilt sashes, black boots.
translations.idiomatic: Front and rear inspection placed six duty-knowing officers within the escort in spread-corner headwraps, purple narrow jackets, gilt sashes, and black boots.

sentences.zh: 承奉班都知一人，太常博士一人，皆朝服，騎，同檢校官。

translations.literal: One director of the Imperial Service Bureau, one Erudite of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices—all in court dress on horseback, same as inspection officers.
translations.idiomatic: One director of the Imperial Service Bureau and one Erudite of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices rode in court dress like the inspection officers.

sentences.zh: 前後巡察宿直將軍八人，服佩同左右點檢，夾輅檢校三衛。

translations.literal: Eight front and rear patrol generals on night duty, dress and arms like left and right inspectors, flanking the chariot to inspect the Three Guards.
translations.idiomatic: Eight front and rear patrol generals on night duty, dressed and armed like the left and right inspectors, flanked the chariot to inspect the Three Guards.

sentences.zh: 陪輅隊：誕馬二匹，珂飾，纓轡，青屜。

translations.literal: Chariot-escort company: two ceremonial horses with ke trappings, tasselled bridles, blue leggings.
translations.idiomatic: The chariot-escort company had two ceremonial horses with ke trappings, tasselled bridles, and blue leggings.

sentences.zh: 乘黃令二人，本品服，分左右。

translations.literal: Two Directors of the Bureau of Equine Transport in proper rank dress, left and right.
translations.idiomatic: Two Directors of the Bureau of Equine Transport in their proper rank dress stood to left and right.

sentences.zh: 次殿前將軍二人，交角襆頭，緋羅繡抹額，紫羅繡辟邪裲襠，紅錦襯袍，錦縢蛇，金帶，烏靴，橫刀，騎。

translations.literal: Next, two Palace Front generals in crossed-corner headwraps, crimson brocade embroidered forehead bands, purple brocade embroidered ward-off-evil cross-collars, red brocade linings, brocade serpents, gold belts, black boots, horizontal sabers, mounted.
translations.idiomatic: Next rode two Palace Front generals in crossed-corner headwraps, crimson brocade embroidered forehead bands, purple brocade embroidered ward-off-evil cross-collars over red brocade linings, brocade serpents, gold belts, black boots, and horizontal sabers.

sentences.zh: 玉輅，太僕卿馭，本品服。

translations.literal: Jade chariot; Grand Master of Equine Transport drives in proper rank dress.
translations.idiomatic: The jade chariot was driven by the Grand Master of Equine Transport in his proper rank dress.

sentences.zh: 千牛大將軍驂乘，交角襆頭，紅抹額，繡瑞牛裲襠，紅錦襯袍，錦螣蛇，金帶，烏靴，橫刀。

translations.literal: Thousand-Ox great general as chariot companion in crossed-corner headwrap, red forehead band, embroidered auspicious-ox cross-collar, red brocade lining, brocade serpent, gold belt, black boots, horizontal saber.
translations.idiomatic: A Thousand-Ox great general served as chariot companion in a crossed-corner headwrap, red forehead band, embroidered auspicious-ox cross-collar over red brocade lining, brocade serpent, gold belt, black boots, and horizontal saber.

sentences.zh: 左右衛將軍，服如千牛大將軍，惟裲襠繡瑞虎文。

translations.literal: Left and right guard generals dressed like Thousand-Ox great generals, only cross-collars embroidered with auspicious tiger pattern.
translations.idiomatic: The left and right guard generals dressed like Thousand-Ox great generals, except that their cross-collars bore embroidered auspicious tiger pattern.

sentences.zh: 陪輅輅馬六匹，珂飾，纓轡，青屜，牽套鞶帶。

translations.literal: Six chariot-escort horses with ke trappings, tasselled bridles, blue leggings, leading harness and belt.
translations.idiomatic: Six chariot-escort horses bore ke trappings, tasselled bridles, blue leggings, and leading harness with belt.

sentences.zh: 步卒凡八十有二人，馭士四人，駕士六十有四人，行馬二人，踏道八人，推竿二人，托叉一人，梯一人，皆平巾，青幘，青繡雲龍花袍，塗金束帶，青靴。

translations.literal: Foot soldiers eighty-two in all: four drivers, sixty-four charioteers, two pacing horses, eight path-levelers, two pole-pushers, one fork-lifter, one ladder-bearer—all in plain caps, green kerchiefs, green embroidered cloud-dragon floral robes, gilt sashes, green boots.
translations.idiomatic: Eighty-two foot soldiers in all—four drivers, sixty-four charioteers, two pacing horses, eight path-levelers, two pole-pushers, one fork-lifter, and one ladder-bearer—all wore plain caps, green kerchiefs, green embroidered cloud-dragon floral robes, gilt sashes, and green boots.

sentences.zh: 教馬官二人，進輅職長二人，皆本品服。

translations.literal: Two horse-training officers, two chariot-entry duty chiefs—all in proper rank dress.
translations.idiomatic: Two horse-training officers and two chariot-entry duty chiefs wore their proper rank dress.

sentences.zh: 夾輅將軍二人，金鳳翅兜牟，金鎖甲，絳環，繡汗胯，金束帶，綠雲花靴。

translations.literal: Two chariot-flanking generals in golden phoenix-wing helmets, golden lock armor, crimson rings, embroidered sweat-trousers, gold sashes, green cloud-floral boots.
translations.idiomatic: Two chariot-flanking generals wore golden phoenix-wing helmets, golden lock armor, crimson rings, embroidered sweat-trousers, gold sashes, and green cloud-floral boots.

sentences.zh: 青瀝水扇二。

translations.literal: Next, two indigo rinsed-water fans.
translations.idiomatic: Next came two indigo rinsed-water fans.

sentences.zh: 次千牛備身二人，皆分左右，交角襆頭，緋羅繡抹額，紫羅繡瑞牛裲襠，紅錦襯袍，金帶，烏靴，橫刀，佩弓矢。

translations.literal: Next, two Thousand-Ox bodyguards to left and right in crossed-corner headwraps, crimson brocade embroidered forehead bands, purple brocade embroidered auspicious-ox cross-collars, red brocade linings, gold belts, black boots, horizontal sabers, bow and arrow at the belt.
translations.idiomatic: Next came two Thousand-Ox bodyguards to left and right in crossed-corner headwraps, crimson brocade embroidered forehead bands, purple brocade embroidered auspicious-ox cross-collars over red brocade linings, gold belts, black boots, horizontal sabers, and bow and arrow at the belt.

sentences.zh: 獻官二人，殿中監六人，內侍十人，皆本品朝服，騎，分左右。

translations.literal: Two presentation officers, six Directors of the Palace Administration, ten eunuchs—all in proper court dress on horseback, left and right.
translations.idiomatic: Two presentation officers, six Directors of the Palace Administration, and ten eunuchs rode in their proper court dress to left and right.

sentences.zh: 千牛備身後，騎而執弓矢者十人，尚衣奉御四人，尚食奉御二人，尚藥奉御二人，皆騎，本品服。

translations.literal: Behind Thousand-Ox bodyguards, ten mounted bow-and-arrow bearers; four Directors of Imperial Wardrobe, two Directors of Imperial Food, two Directors of Imperial Medicine—all mounted in proper rank dress.
translations.idiomatic: Behind the Thousand-Ox bodyguards rode ten bow-and-arrow bearers, with four Directors of Imperial Wardrobe, two Directors of Imperial Food, and two Directors of Imperial Medicine, all mounted in their proper rank dress.

sentences.zh: 次腰輿，黃纻絲銷金雲龍蒙復，步卒凡十有三人，舁八人，道扇四人，黃傘一人，皆交角金花襆頭，紅質孫控鶴襖，金束帶，翁鞋。

translations.literal: Next, waist palanquin with yellow ramie gilded cloud-dragon saddle cover; foot soldiers thirteen in all—eight bearers, four path fans, one yellow parasol—all in crossed-corner gilt-floral headwraps, red zhisun Crane-Control jackets, gold sashes, saweng shoes.
translations.idiomatic: Next came a waist palanquin with a yellow ramie gilded cloud-dragon saddle cover, borne by thirteen foot soldiers in all—eight bearers, four path fans, and one yellow parasol—all in crossed-corner gilt-floral headwraps, red zhisun Crane-Control jackets, gold sashes, and saweng shoes.

sentences.zh: 尚舍奉御二人，騎左，尚輦奉御二人，騎右，皆朝服。

translations.literal: Two Directors of Imperial Lodging mounted left, two Directors of Imperial Palanquins mounted right—all in court dress.
translations.idiomatic: Two Directors of Imperial Lodging rode to the left and two Directors of Imperial Palanquins to the right, all in court dress.

sentences.zh: 從者三十有四人，服同前隊。

translations.literal: Thirty-four attendants, dress same as prior company.
translations.idiomatic: Thirty-four attendants dressed like the prior company.

sentences.zh: 大神牙門旗隊：都點檢一人，騎，交角襆頭，緋羅繡抹額，紫羅繡瑞麟裲襠，紅錦襯袍。

translations.literal: Great spirit gate-banner company: one chief inspector mounted in crossed-corner headwrap, crimson brocade embroidered forehead band, purple brocade embroidered auspicious-qilin cross-collar, red brocade lining.
translations.idiomatic: The great spirit gate-banner company placed one chief inspector on horseback in a crossed-corner headwrap, crimson brocade embroidered forehead band, purple brocade embroidered auspicious-qilin cross-collar, and red brocade lining.

sentences.zh: 次監門大將軍二人，分左右，騎，服如都點檢，惟裲襠紫繡獅文。

translations.literal: Next, two Gate Guard great generals to left and right, mounted, dress like chief inspector, only cross-collars purple embroidered with lion pattern.
translations.idiomatic: Next rode two Gate Guard great generals to left and right, dressed like the chief inspector except for purple cross-collars embroidered with lion pattern.

sentences.zh: 門凡三重。

translations.literal: Gates three in all.
translations.idiomatic: There were three gates in all.

sentences.zh: 親衛郎將帥甲士，分左右，夾輅而陣，繞出輅後，合執氅者二，為第一門。

translations.literal: Close-guard commandants leading armored men left and right, flanking the chariot in formation, looping behind the chariot; two bearing standards merged as the first gate.
translations.idiomatic: Close-guard commandants led armored men to left and right, flanking the chariot in formation and looping behind it; two standard-bearers merged to form the first gate.

sentences.zh: 翊衛郎將帥護尉，夾親衛而陣，繞出輅後，合為第二門，監門校尉二人，騎。

translations.literal: Assist-guard commandants leading guard officers flanked the close guard in formation, looped behind the chariot, merged as the second gate; two Gate Guard squad commanders mounted.
translations.idiomatic: Assist-guard commandants led guard officers flanking the close guard in formation, looped behind the chariot, and merged as the second gate, with two Gate Guard squad commanders mounted.

sentences.zh: 左右衛大將軍帥甲士，執五色龍鳳旗，夾護尉而陣，繞出輅後，合牙門旗二，為第三門，監門校尉二人主之。

translations.literal: Left and right guard great generals leading armored men bearing five-color dragon-phoenix banners flanked the guard officers in formation, looped behind the chariot, merged two gate banners as the third gate, directed by two Gate Guard squad commanders.
translations.idiomatic: Left and right guard great generals led armored men bearing five-color dragon-phoenix banners, flanking the guard officers in formation, looping behind the chariot; two gate banners merged as the third gate under two Gate Guard squad commanders.

sentences.zh: 服色詳見外仗。

translations.literal: Dress colors detailed in the outer escort.
translations.idiomatic: Dress colors are detailed in the outer escort section.

sentences.zh: 雲和樂後部：雲和署丞二人，本品服，騎，分左右。

translations.literal: Cloud-and-Harmony music rear section: two Cloud-and-Harmony bureau deputies in proper rank dress on horseback, left and right.
translations.idiomatic: The Cloud-and-Harmony music rear section placed two bureau deputies on horseback in their proper rank dress, to left and right.

sentences.zh: 領前行，戲竹二，排簫二，簫管二，歌工二，凡十人，皆騎，花襆頭，紫絁生色花袍，塗金帶，烏靴。

translations.literal: Leading the advance: two theatre bamboo, two panpipes, two xiao pipes, two singers—ten men in all, all mounted in floral headwraps, purple silk cloud-floral robes, gilt belts, black boots.
translations.idiomatic: Leading the advance were two theatre bamboo, two panpipes, two xiao pipes, and two singers—ten men in all—mounted in floral headwraps, purple silk cloud-floral robes, gilt belts, and black boots.

sentences.zh: 次琵琶四，箏四，箜篌四，緌四，頭管六，方響二，龍笛六，杖鼓十，工四十人，皆騎，服同上，惟絁色紅。

translations.literal: Next, four pipa, four zheng, four konghou, four ruan, six touguan, two fangxiang, six dragon flutes, ten staff drums, forty musicians—all mounted, dress as above, only silk color red.
translations.idiomatic: Next followed four pipa, four zheng, four konghou, four ruan, six touguan, two fangxiang, six dragon flutes, ten staff drums, and forty musicians, all mounted in the same dress but with red silk.

sentences.zh: 從者二人，服同前隊。

translations.literal: Two attendants, dress same as prior company.
translations.idiomatic: Two attendants dressed like the prior company.

sentences.zh: 後黃麾隊：玄武幢一，絳麾二，徒三人，皆武弁，紫絁生色龜雲花袍，紫羅勒帛，紫靴。

translations.literal: Rear yellow banner company: one black-warrior pennant, two crimson banners, three foot soldiers—all in martial caps, purple silk cloud-tortoise floral robes, purple silk belts, purple boots.
translations.idiomatic: The rear yellow banner company had one black-warrior pennant and two crimson banners, with three foot soldiers in martial caps, purple silk cloud-tortoise floral robes, purple silk belts, and purple boots.

sentences.zh: 次黃麾，執者一人，夾者二人，皆騎。

translations.literal: Next, yellow banner—one bearer, two flanking, all mounted.
translations.idiomatic: Next came the yellow banner with one bearer and two flanking men, all mounted.

sentences.zh: 豹尾一，執者一人，夾者二人，皆騎，武弁，紫生色寶相花袍，紫勒帛，紫靴。

translations.literal: One leopard tail—one bearer, two flanking, all mounted in martial caps, purple cloud-floral robes, purple belts, purple boots.
translations.idiomatic: One leopard tail followed with one bearer and two flanking men, all mounted in martial caps, purple cloud-floral robes, purple belts, and purple boots.

sentences.zh: 玄武黑甲掩後隊：金吾將軍一人，騎，中道，交角襆頭，緋羅繡抹額，紫羅繡辟邪裲襠，紅錦襯袍，金帶，錦螣蛇，烏靴，佩刀。

translations.literal: Black-armor black-warrior rear-cover company: one Golden Guard general mounted on the central path in crossed-corner headwrap, crimson brocade embroidered forehead band, purple brocade embroidered ward-off-evil cross-collar, red brocade lining, gold belt, brocade serpent, black boots, saber at belt.
translations.idiomatic: The black-armor black-warrior rear-cover company placed one Golden Guard general on horseback on the central path in a crossed-corner headwrap, crimson brocade embroidered forehead band, purple brocade embroidered ward-off-evil cross-collar over red brocade lining, gold belt, brocade serpent, black boots, and saber at the belt.

sentences.zh: 後衛指揮使二人，騎，分左右，服同各衛指揮使，帥甲騎五十有七人。

translations.literal: Two rear-guard commanders mounted left and right, dress like each guard commander, leading fifty-seven armored horsemen.
translations.idiomatic: Two rear-guard commanders rode to left and right dressed like each guard commander, leading fifty-seven armored horsemen.

sentences.zh: 玄武旗一，執者一人，夾者二人。

translations.literal: One black-warrior banner—one bearer, two flanking.
translations.idiomatic: One black-warrior banner had one bearer and two flanking men.

sentences.zh: 小金龍鳳黑旗二，執者二人，皆黑兜牟，金飾，黑甲絳環，汗胯，束帶，靴，帶弓矢器仗，馬黑金色獅子甲，珂飾。

translations.literal: Two small golden dragon-phoenix black banners, two bearers—all in black helmets with gold ornament, black armor with crimson rings, sweat-trousers, sashes, boots, bow-arrow arms and gear; horses in black-gold lion armor with ke trappings.
translations.idiomatic: Two small golden dragon-phoenix black banners had two bearers in black helmets with gold ornament, black armor with crimson rings, sweat-trousers, sashes, boots, and full bow-arrow arms and gear, on horses in black-gold lion armor with ke trappings.

sentences.zh: 槊四十人，弩十人，黑兜牟，黑甲絳環，汗胯，束帶，靴，帶弓矢器仗，馬黑甲，珂飾。

translations.literal: Forty spearmen, ten crossbowmen—all black helmets, black armor with crimson rings, sweat-trousers, sashes, boots, bow-arrow arms and gear; horses in black armor with ke trappings.
translations.idiomatic: Forty spearmen and ten crossbowmen wore black helmets, black armor with crimson rings, sweat-trousers, sashes, boots, and full bow-arrow arms and gear, on horses in black armor with ke trappings.

sentences.zh: 執衛司暴槊二人，錦帽，紫生色辟邪文袍，鍍金帶，烏靴。

translations.literal: Two Guard Bureau spear-display men in brocade caps, purple cloud ward-off-evil robes, gilt belts, black boots.
translations.idiomatic: Two Guard Bureau spear-display men wore brocade caps, purple cloud ward-off-evil robes, gilt belts, and black boots.

sentences.zh: 從者三人，服同前隊。

translations.literal: Three attendants, dress same as prior company.
translations.idiomatic: Three attendants dressed like the prior company.

sentences.zh: 金鼓隊：金鼓旗二，執者二人，引護者八人，皆五色絁巾，生色寶相花五色袍，五色勒帛，靴，佩劍，引護者加弓矢，分左右。

translations.literal: Gold-and-drum company: two gold-and-drum banners, two bearers, eight escorts—all five-color silk headcloths, five-color cloud-floral robes, five-color belts, boots, swords; escorts add bow and arrow, left and right.
translations.idiomatic: The gold-and-drum company had two gold-and-drum banners with two bearers and eight escorts in five-color silk headcloths, five-color cloud-floral robes, five-color belts, boots, and swords; the escorts also bore bow and arrow, to left and right.

sentences.zh: 次折沖都尉二人，交角襆頭，緋羅繡抹額，紫羅繡辟邪裲襠，紅錦襯袍，金帶，錦螣蛇，騎。

translations.literal: Next, two assault-vanquisher commandants in crossed-corner headwraps, crimson brocade embroidered forehead bands, purple brocade embroidered ward-off-evil cross-collars, red brocade linings, gold belts, brocade serpents, mounted.
translations.idiomatic: Next rode two assault-vanquisher commandants in crossed-corner headwraps, crimson brocade embroidered forehead bands, purple brocade embroidered ward-off-evil cross-collars over red brocade linings, gold belts, and brocade serpents.

sentences.zh: 帥步士凡百二十人，鼓二十四人，鉦二十四人，並黃絁巾黃絁生色寶相花袍，黃勒帛，黃靴。

translations.literal: Leading foot soldiers one hundred twenty in all: twenty-four drummers, twenty-four cymbalists—all yellow silk headcloths, yellow silk cloud-floral robes, yellow belts, yellow boots.
translations.idiomatic: They led one hundred twenty foot soldiers in all—twenty-four drummers and twenty-four cymbalists—in yellow silk headcloths, yellow silk cloud-floral robes, yellow belts, and yellow boots.

sentences.zh: 角二十四人，紅絁巾，紅絁生色寶相花袍，紅勒帛，紅靴。

translations.literal: Twenty-four horn players in red silk headcloths, red silk cloud-floral robes, red belts, red boots.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty-four horn players wore red silk headcloths, red silk cloud-floral robes, red belts, and red boots.

sentences.zh: 車輻棒二十四人，長刀二十四人，並金飾青兜牟，青甲絳環，白繡汗胯，束帶，青雲靴。

translations.literal: Twenty-four chariot-hub clubs, twenty-four long sabers—all gilt green helmets, green armor with crimson rings, white embroidered sweat-trousers, sashes, green cloud boots.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty-four chariot-hub clubs and twenty-four long sabers were borne by men in gilt green helmets, green armor with crimson rings, white embroidered sweat-trousers, sashes, and green cloud boots.

sentences.zh: 清遊隊：舍人二人，四品服，騎導。

translations.literal: Pure-travel company: two Gentlemen of the Palace in fourth-rank dress on horseback as guides.
translations.idiomatic: The pure-travel company placed two Gentlemen of the Palace in fourth-rank dress on horseback to guide the way.

sentences.zh: 金吾折沖二人，交角襆頭，緋羅繡抹額，紫羅繡辟邪裲襠，紅錦襯袍，金帶，錦螣蛇，橫刀，佩弓矢，騎，分左右，帥步士凡百有十人。

translations.literal: Two Golden Guard assault vanquishers in crossed-corner headwraps, crimson brocade embroidered forehead bands, purple brocade embroidered ward-off-evil cross-collars, red brocade linings, gold belts, brocade serpents, horizontal sabers, bow and arrow at the belt, mounted left and right, leading one hundred ten foot soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Two Golden Guard assault vanquishers rode to left and right in crossed-corner headwraps, crimson brocade embroidered forehead bands, purple brocade embroidered ward-off-evil cross-collars over red brocade linings, gold belts, brocade serpents, horizontal sabers, and bow and arrow at the belt, leading one hundred ten foot soldiers.

sentences.zh: 白澤旗二，執者二人，引護者八人。

translations.literal: Two white-unicorn banners, two bearers, eight escorts.
translations.idiomatic: Two white-unicorn banners had two bearers and eight escorts.

sentences.zh: 次執弩二十人，次執槊二十人，次執弓二十人，次執槊二十人，次執弓二十人，皆甲騎冠，金飾，綠畫甲絳環，白繡汗胯，束帶，綠雲靴，佩弓矢器仗，馬金飾朱畫甲，珂飾，分左右。

translations.literal: Next, twenty crossbow bearers, next twenty spear bearers, next twenty bow bearers, next twenty spear bearers, next twenty bow bearers—all armored cavalry caps with gold ornament, green-painted armor with crimson rings, white embroidered sweat-trousers, sashes, green cloud boots, bow-arrow arms and gear, horses with gold ornament vermilion-painted armor and ke trappings, left and right.
translations.idiomatic: Next came twenty crossbow bearers, then twenty spear bearers, then twenty bow bearers, then twenty spear bearers, then twenty bow bearers—all in armored cavalry caps with gold ornament, green-painted armor with crimson rings, white embroidered sweat-trousers, sashes, green cloud boots, and full bow-arrow arms and gear, on horses with gold ornament vermilion-painted armor and ke trappings, to left and right.

sentences.zh: 佽飛隊：鐵甲佽飛，執槊者十有二人，甲騎冠，鐵甲，佩弓矢器仗，馬鐵甲，珂飾。

translations.literal: Flying Service company: iron-armored Flying Service, twelve spear bearers in armored cavalry caps, iron armor, bow-arrow arms and gear, horses in iron armor with ke trappings.
translations.idiomatic: The Flying Service company comprised iron-armored Flying Service men—twelve spear bearers in armored cavalry caps and iron armor with full bow-arrow arms and gear, on horses in iron armor with ke trappings.

sentences.zh: 次金吾果毅二人，交角襆頭，緋絁繡抹額，紫羅繡辟邪裲襠，紅錦襯袍，金帶，錦螣蛇，橫刀，弓矢，騎。

translations.literal: Next, two Golden Guard resolute officers in crossed-corner headwraps, crimson silk embroidered forehead bands, purple brocade embroidered ward-off-evil cross-collars, red brocade linings, gold belts, brocade serpents, horizontal sabers, bow and arrow, mounted.
translations.idiomatic: Next rode two Golden Guard resolute officers in crossed-corner headwraps, crimson silk embroidered forehead bands, purple brocade embroidered ward-off-evil cross-collars over red brocade linings, gold belts, brocade serpents, horizontal sabers, and bow and arrow.

translations.idiomatic: They curved around to flank the gate.

sentences.zh: 右衛白甲隊：右衛指揮使二人，騎，服同中衛指揮使，帥騎士凡七十有四人。

translations.literal: Right Guard white-armor company: two Right Guard commanders on horseback, dress like Central Guard commanders, leading seventy-four horsemen in all.
translations.idiomatic: The Right Guard white-armor company had two commanders on horseback dressed like Central Guard commanders, leading seventy-four horsemen.

sentences.zh: 執大白鳳旗一人左，大白龍旗一人右，次小白鳳旗一人左，小白龍旗一人右，次大白龍旗一人左，大白鳳旗一人右，次小白龍旗一人左，小白鳳旗一人右，次大白鳳旗一人左，大白龍旗一人右，每旗從以持白槊者四人。

translations.literal: One great white phoenix flag on the left, one great white dragon on the right; next one small white phoenix on the left, one small white dragon on the right; next one great white dragon on the left, one great white phoenix on the right; next one small white phoenix on the left, one small white dragon on the right; next one great white phoenix on the left, one great white dragon on the right—each flag escorted by four men bearing white spears.
translations.idiomatic: Great white phoenix left and great white dragon right, then small white phoenix left and small white dragon right, then great white dragon left and great white phoenix right, then small white phoenix left and small white dragon right, then great white phoenix left and great white dragon right—each flag with four escorts bearing white spears.

sentences.zh: 次小白鳳旗一人左，小白龍旗一人右，次大白龍旗一人左，大白鳳旗一人右，皆從以持白槊者五人。

translations.literal: Next one small white phoenix on the left, one small white dragon on the right; next one great white dragon on the left, one great white phoenix on the right—all escorted by five men bearing white spears.
translations.idiomatic: Then small white phoenix left and small white dragon right, then great white dragon left and great white phoenix right, each group with five escorts bearing white spears.

sentences.zh: 皆白兜牟，金飾白甲，絳環，汗胯，束帶，靴，佩弓矢器仗，馬白甲，珂飾。

translations.literal: All wore white helmets with gold ornament, white armor, crimson rings, sweat-trousers, sashes, boots, and full bow-arrow arms and gear; horses bore white armor with ke trappings.
translations.idiomatic: All wore white helmets with gold ornament, white armor, crimson rings, sweat-trousers, sashes, and boots, with full arms and gear on horses in white armor with ke trappings.

sentences.zh: 從者二人，服同前隊。

translations.literal: Two attendants, dress like the prior company.
translations.idiomatic: Two attendants dressed like the prior company.

sentences.zh: 折繞陪門。

translations.literal: They curved around to flank the gate.
translations.idiomatic: They curved around to flank the gate.

sentences.zh: 牙門四：監門中郎將二人，服佩同各衛指揮使，騎，分左右。

translations.literal: Four Gate Teeth: two supervising gate middle-rank generals, dress and fittings like each guard commander, on horseback to left and right.
translations.idiomatic: The four Gate Teeth: two supervising gate middle-rank generals on horseback to left and right, dressed like each guard commander.

sentences.zh: 次左衛，次前衛，次中衛，次右衛。

translations.literal: Next the Left Guard, then the Front Guard, then the Central Guard, then the Right Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Next came the Left Guard, then the Front Guard, then the Central Guard, then the Right Guard.

sentences.zh: 牙門旗各二，色並赤。

translations.literal: Gate Teeth flags two each, all red in color.
translations.idiomatic: Each Gate Teeth section had two flags, all red.

sentences.zh: 監門校尉各二人，騎，服佩同各衛之執旗者。

translations.literal: Gate supervisors two each, on horseback, dress and fittings like each guard's flag bearers.
translations.idiomatic: Each section had two gate supervisors on horseback, dressed like that guard's flag bearers.

sentences.zh: 從者十人，服同前隊。

translations.literal: Ten attendants, dress like the prior company.
translations.idiomatic: Ten attendants dressed like the prior company.
